zh.effect: 希望+1，源石锭+3，使当前或下次进入的岁兽残识中所有常乐节点变为可探索状态，在部分常乐节点中有奇妙的作用
zh.flavor: 岁兽残识第九个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为铜轮。以好奇煅烧，便可见其脱逸的豁达。

en.name: Hai-Shih Stove
en.effect: Wondrous effects in Retrieve nodes; +2 Candles after clearing all Retrieve nodes (only triggers once)
en.flavor: An object condensed from the twelfth Acute Hour of Sui, shaped as a stove. With myriad bestial Sui deeds and mortal disputes all on the same land, why differentiate between the two?

ja.name: 亥食の竈
ja.effect: 【拾遺】で不思議な効果を発揮する。全ての【拾遺】を通過すると、燭火+2（1回のみ発動）
ja.flavor: 歳獣の残識が第十二の時辰に入骨し、凝縮されて形を持った物であり、竈の形を取っている。歳獣の諸相は様々で、人の世の是非も一概には言えぬものだ。同じ大地にいるというのに、なぜ分け隔てが必要なのか？

zh.name: 亥食灶
zh.effect: 在拾遗节点中有奇妙的作用，完成所有拾遗节点后获得2烛火，最多触发1次
zh.flavor: 岁兽残识第十二个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为锅灶。岁兽种种，人间是非，同在一片大地，为何要泾渭分明？

en.name: Yin-Shih Flask
en.effect: +2 Hope, reveals some Legend and Decision nodes on the current or next Sui's Remnant Consciousness visit; wondrous effects in some Legend nodes
en.flavor: An object condensed from the third Acute Hour of Sui, shaped as a flask. With tales as wine, one can see unrestrained freedom within.

ja.name: 寅詩の壺
ja.effect: 希望+2、滞在中または次に入る【歳獣の残識】において、一部の【伝説】と【決断】が探索可能状態になる。一部の【伝説】で不思議な効果を発揮する
ja.flavor: 歳獣の残識が第三の時辰に入骨し、凝縮されて形を持った物であり、酒壺の形を取っている。逸話を以て酒の肴とすれば、その虚ろに漂う逍遥が見えてくる。

zh.name: 寅诗壶
zh.effect: 希望+2，使当前或下次进入的岁兽残识中部分传说与抉择节点变为可探索状态，在部分传说节点中有奇妙的作用
zh.flavor: 岁兽残识第三个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为酒壶。以轶事佐酒，便可见其虚漫的逍遥。

en.name: Wei-Chien Rule
en.effect: +6 Ingots; wondrous effects in Tavern nodes
en.flavor: An object condensed from the eighth Acute Hour of Sui, shaped as a rule. With knowledge of construction, one can see obstructive amiability within.

ja.name: 未建の尺
ja.effect: 源石錐+6、【古肆】で不思議な効果を発揮する
ja.flavor: 歳獣の残識が第八の時辰に入骨し、凝縮されて形を持った物であり、尺の形を取っている。認知を以て構築すれば、その滞り塞がれた親和が見えてくる。

zh.name: 未建尺
zh.effect: 源石锭+6，在故肆节点中有奇妙的作用
zh.flavor: 岁兽残识第八个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为量尺。以认知构筑，便可见其滞塞的亲和。

en.name: Great Tomb Whistle
en.effect: After leaving this shop, immediately enter Sui's Remnant Consciousness and gain +3 Candles
en.flavor: A wood whistle crafted from the Great Tomb Tree. When blown, one's consciousness drifts away from the body, while the whistle turns into fuel to light a steady fire inside the mind.

ja.name: 鎮陵の笛
ja.effect: 今回ショップを離れる時、即座に【歳獣の残識】に入り、燭火+3
ja.flavor: 鎮陵木で作られた笛。吹き鳴らせば、意識はその息とともに肉体を離れ、木の笛は薪となって、心を鎮める燭火を灯す。

zh.name: 镇陵哨
zh.effect: 本次离开商店时，立即进入岁兽残识并获得3烛火
zh.flavor: 镇陵木所做的哨子，吹响后意识便会随着气流一同离体，木哨则会化作柴薪，点燃稳定心神的烛火。

en.name: Smoky Candle
en.effect: Turns an Operator into a Candleguest
en.flavor: An ash candle created from the Hall of Candles's fireworks. It dissipates when lit, but with the past seen in the fleeting smoke, it lights an eternal flame within one's heart.

ja.name: 煙燭
ja.effect: 伺燭客でないオペレーター1名の燭火を点す
ja.flavor: 燭堂の煙火を集めて作られた灰の蝋燭。灯せばすぐに消えてしまうが、その消えゆく煙の中に見た過去は、誰かの心に不滅の蝋燭として残る。

zh.name: 烟烛
zh.effect: 为一名未燃烛的干员燃烛
zh.flavor: 收集烛堂烟火后制作的灰烛，点燃便会消散，然而在那逝去烟云中所见的往事，将在某人的心中塑成一根不灭的心烛。

en.name: Scout's Scope
en.effect: Enemies take increased damage from allied units as range increases (max 100%)
en.flavor: Lock on, aim, fire, and destroy the enemy's will to resist, all in the name of a better future that Scout will never see. Maybe you can do it for him.

ja.name: Scoutの狙撃スコープ
ja.effect: 味方全員は攻撃時、攻撃対象との距離が離れるほど与ダメージが上昇（最大+100%まで）
ja.flavor: 狙いを定め、精度を保って引き金を引き、敵の抵抗の意思をくじく。そのすべてはかの遠大な未来のためだ。もはやScoutにはそれを見ることはできないが、あなたが代わりに見届けることはできるかもしれない。

zh.name: Scout的狙击镜
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到我方单位伤害时，距离伤害来源越远受到的伤害越高（最高100%）
zh.flavor: 锁定目标、维持精度、扣下扳机、摧毁敌人抵抗的意志，这一切都是为了那个更远大的未来。Scout已经没有机会看到了，或许你可以帮忙见证。

en.name: Great Banshee's Veil
en.effect: All enemies take +10% Arts damage and +50% Elemental Injury
en.flavor: The former Lord of the Banshees always seemed amicable, as if that were her only side... until she pulled out her bone pen, sang softly, and impaled agonizing wails into the minds of every intruder.

ja.name: 謡う者のベール
ja.effect: 敵が受ける術ダメージ+10%、元素損傷+50%
ja.flavor: 先代のバンシーの主は、あたかもずっとそうだったかのように、友好的な印象を与えたが……それも彼女が骨筆を抜き、優しい歌声で侵入者一人ひとりの脳裏に悲鳴を打ち込むまでのことだった。

zh.name: 讴歌者面纱
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的法术伤害+10%，受到的元素损伤+50%
zh.flavor: 前任女妖之主留给人一种亲切的印象，好似她从来都是如此......直到她拔出骨笔，轻声吟唱，将哀嚎钉入每一个入侵者的思维。

en.name: Disaster's Origin
en.effect: All enemies take +20% Arts damage and +100% Elemental Injury
en.flavor: The Sarkaz dug through the Targangils Prime Vein and Originium crystals spurted forth from Kazdel. Their fall was inevitable, so they wanted everything on this great land to be buried together with them.

ja.name: 災いの源
ja.effect: 敵が受ける術ダメージ+20%、元素損傷+100%
ja.flavor: サルカズがタルガンギルス主鉱脈を掘削する際、鉱脈を断ち切ってしまったことで、源石の結晶がカズデルから湧き出る事態となった。とうに滅亡を運命づけられていたサルカズたちは、この大地のすべてを道連れにすると決めた。

zh.name: 灾难之源
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的法术伤害+20%，受到的元素损伤+100%
zh.flavor: 萨卡兹掘断了塔尔干主矿脉，源石结晶从卡兹戴尔喷涌而出。萨卡兹的败亡早已注定，于是他们要大地上的一切成为陪葬。

en.name: Pure White Dance Shoes
en.effect: Can deploy Ranged Operators on Low Ground tiles
en.flavor: The Ursus dancer's steps are swift and elegant, her body moving as she wills.

ja.name: 純白のトウシューズ
ja.effect: 地面マスに遠距離オペレーターを配置可能
ja.flavor: ウルサスの踊り子は軽やかに舞い、優美な肢体を天地の間に伸ばす。

zh.name: 洁白的舞鞋
zh.effect: 可以在低地部署远程位干员
zh.flavor: 乌萨斯的舞者轻盈灵动，于天地间尽情舒展身姿。

en.name: Ribbon of Honor
en.effect: All allied units have +100% ATK when blocking only 1 enemy
en.flavor: Numerous actors have played this character, yet none of them were able to save the character's dearest friend.

ja.name: グローリーサッシュ
ja.effect: 味方全員はブロック中の敵が1体のみの時、攻撃力+100%
ja.flavor: 無数の役者がこの人物を演じてきたが、誰も彼にとっての無二の親友は救えなかった。

zh.name: 荣耀绶带
zh.effect: 所有我方单位仅阻挡1名敌人时，攻击力+100%
zh.flavor: 曾有无数位演员出演这个角色，但永远救不了这个角色心目中的挚友。

en.name: Survivor Contract
en.effect: At the start of battle, a random Operator gains +20% ATK and DEF, plus an additional +20% at the end of each victorious battle
en.flavor: A very long contract, in which every term and condition is the result of experience, leaving no room for chance or sentiment. Satisfy them all to be the final survivor.

ja.name: 生還者の契約
ja.effect: 戦闘開始時、ランダムなオペレーター1名の攻撃力・防御力+20%、さらに戦闘をクリアするたびに次の戦闘での上昇値が追加で+20%
ja.flavor: 膨大な数の項目が記された契約書。その項目の一つ一つはどれも、感覚と運を取り除いた純粋な経験の賜物であり、一つずつ順を追って遂行することで、最後の生存者となることができる。

zh.name: 生还者合约
zh.effect: 战斗开始时，使随机一名干员攻击力和防御力+20%，且每次战斗胜利后额外+20%
zh.flavor: 一本包含海量条目的合约书。书中记录的每一项条款都是抛弃感性与运气的经验结晶，逐一履行，便能成为幸存的最后一人。

en.name: Four-Leaf Clover Fossil
en.effect: Gain an additional choice when a Collectible drops from a Wish Fulfilled node or after battle
en.flavor: A symbol of luck that Magallan found in a place all but devoid of life. The rock has no doubt experienced many violent changes of the lands, but it survived, giving those who come across it a small bit of lingering hope.

ja.name: 四つ葉の化石
ja.effect: 【願うままに】にいる時もしくは戦闘勝利後、獲得できる秘宝の選択肢が1つ増加
ja.flavor: マゼランが生命終焉の地で見つけた幸運の象徴。この石は大地の激変を経験して、生き残り、わずかな希望を発見者に託した。

zh.name: 四叶草化石
zh.effect: 我方在得偿所愿节点和战斗后掉落收藏品时，增加一个可选项
zh.flavor: 麦哲伦在生命绝迹之所找到的幸运象征。这块石头无疑经历过大地的剧变，但它还是幸存下来，将残留的小小希望留给了发现它的人。

en.name: Fearless Blade
en.effect: When the battle begins, the Operator with the highest DP Cost gains +50% ATK and DEF
en.flavor: Before Kazdel's gates he stood, an impregnable bulwark. Gaulish artilleries, Leithanian casters, and Victorian Knights all took their shots at him. Yet, even when the gates fell and the coalition retreated, the Goliath did not yield an inch.

ja.name: 恐れ知らずの刃
ja.effect: 作戦開始時、配置コストが最も高いオペレーターの攻撃力・防御力+50%
ja.flavor: 彼は城門の前に立ち、カズデルのためにこの門を守っていた。ガリアの砲兵部隊、リターニアの術師団、そしてヴィクトリアの騎士たちが次から次へと攻め込んで、このたった一人のサルカズしかいない防衛線を突破しようと試みた。しかし、城門が破壊され、連合軍が撤退したあとになっても、このゴリアテの剣士は一歩も引き下がりはしなかった。

zh.name: 无惧之刃
zh.effect: 作战开始时，我方部署费用最高的干员攻击力与防御力+50%
zh.flavor: 他站在城门前，为卡兹戴尔守住这处门户。高卢火炮队、莱塔尼亚术师团、维多利亚骑士轮番上阵，想要突破这只有一名萨卡兹的防线。可直到城门被轰碎，直到联军决定撤退，这位歌利亚剑士都没有后退一步。

en.name: Godmother's Token
en.effect: All enemy units have -17% ATK
en.flavor: A laurel of bones, the token of Signora Sicilia. This symbol of order will smooth the turbulence of all desires, for conflict is not allowed. Genuine or counterfeit, it still demands you to kneel.

ja.name: 教母の印
ja.effect: 敵全員の攻撃力-17%
ja.flavor: 骨で作られた桂冠、ミズ・シチリアの印。この秩序の象徴は蠢く欲望を制圧し、闘争を禁ずる。嘘か真かはさておき、ただ跪くがよい。

zh.name: 教母的信物
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的攻击力-17%
zh.flavor: 骨质的桂冠，西西里夫人的信物。秩序的象征将铲平起伏的欲望，斗争不被允许。无论真假，跪下。

en.name: Fissured Restraints
en.effect: All enemy units have -7% ATK
en.flavor: It seems this sturdy band was once used to restrain something terrifying... Help...

ja.name: 裂けた拘束ベルト
ja.effect: 敵全員の攻撃力-7%
ja.flavor: この頑丈なベルトは、何か恐ろしいものを縛っていたらしい……勘弁してくれ。

zh.name: 开裂的束缚带
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的攻击力-7%
zh.flavor: 这根坚固的带子似乎绑过什么恐怖的东西......救命......

en.name: Living Woodplate
en.effect: All allied melee units gain a Barrier equal to 50% of their Max HP on deployment
en.flavor: Shamans know the formidable will to survive that trees possess, so when a warrior has a similar will, they invite the trees to be their armor.

ja.name: 樹木の鎧
ja.effect: 味方近距離ユニットは配置時、最大HPの50%までの被ダメージを吸収できるバリアを獲得
ja.flavor: シャーマンたちは、樹木の生への執着を理解している。それゆえに、戦士が同様の意志を持っている時、彼らは樹木を戦士の鎧に使わせてもらうのだ。

zh.name: 活木甲
zh.effect: 所有我方近战单位部署时获得相当于最大生命50%的屏障
zh.flavor: 萨满们知晓树木对于生存的执着，所以当战士也拥有这种意志时，他们便会邀请树木成为战士的护甲。

en.name: Snow Doe's Glove
en.effect: All allied units gain ASPD +80 and obtain 50% Physical and Arts Dodge for 30s when blocking 3 or more enemies
en.flavor: She shoots the last three arrows in her quiver at the Frozen Monstrosity, who used them to end her life.

ja.name: 雪の牝鹿の手袋
ja.effect: 味方が敵を3体以上ブロック中とそれ以降の30秒間、攻撃速度+80、物理・術回避+50%
ja.flavor: 彼女は矢筒に残された最後の三矢を寒災に向けて放ったが、寒災はそれを用いて彼女の命を奪っていった。

zh.name: 雪牝的护手
zh.effect: 所有我方单位阻挡3名及以上敌人后，攻击速度+80，获得50%的物理和法术闪避，持续30秒
zh.flavor: 她向寒灾射去了箭袋中最后的三支箭，寒灾用它们结束了她的生命。

en.name: Roundstone Altar
en.effect: Chance to permanently increase all allied units' ATK and DEF by 5% after a victorious battle (Stacks up to 10 times)
en.flavor: An offering made is returned with a reward. So simple it was, that people never questioned what they were sacrificing to.

ja.name: 丸い石の祭壇
ja.effect: 戦闘勝利後、一定確率で永続的に味方全員の攻撃力・防御力+5%（最大10回まで）
ja.flavor: 供物を捧げれば見返りがある。それがあまりに便利すぎたせいで、人々は自分が何に供物を捧げているのか考えることさえしなかった。

zh.name: 圆石祭坛
zh.effect: 战斗胜利后有概率使所有我方单位的攻击力和防御力永久+5%（最多叠加10层）
zh.flavor: 送上祭品，获得回馈。它是如此地便利，以至于人们都没有思考过，他们到底在向什么献祭。

en.name: Black Tulip
en.effect: Allied Operators gradually gain ATK when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +60% after 60s; bonus is reset when skill ends
en.flavor: Silence crushed the Iberians, so she knows she must speak up. If her words aren't sharp enough, her sword will speak for her.

ja.name: 黒いチューリップ
ja.effect: 全てのオペレーターは、スキル未発動の間、60秒かけて攻撃力が+60%まで徐々に上昇。スキル終了時、効果はリセットされる
ja.flavor: 沈黙がイベリア人を押しつぶした。だからこそ彼女は声を上げるのだ。言葉に鋭さが足りないというのなら、剣を以て語ればいい。

zh.name: 黑色郁金香
zh.effect: 所有我方干员技能未开启时60秒内攻击力逐渐提升至最高+60%，每次技能结束时失去该加成
zh.flavor: 沉默压垮了伊比利亚人，所以她要发声，如果言语不够锐利，那就以剑代言。

en.name: Emergency Stimulant
en.effect: Operators gain ASPD as their HP decreases, up to +60 ASPD at 30% HP
en.flavor: An injection commonly used in Rim Billiton's local mines. Its strong active ingredient can stimulate the workers' senses and ensure their work efficiency in extreme environments. When life and their project both present their deadlines, sometimes the choice is simpler than one might think.

ja.name: 緊急活性剤
ja.effect: オペレーターの残りHPの割合が低いほど、攻撃速度が上昇（上昇最大値：HPが30%の時、攻撃速度+60）
ja.flavor: レム・ビリトン現地の採掘場で常用されている一種の注射薬。強い活性成分が労働者の感覚器官を刺激し、極限環境下における労働効率を保証する。時間に限りがあるのは、生命も工事も同じことだ。彼らに言わせれば、これは単なる選択に過ぎない。

zh.name: 紧急活性剂
zh.effect: 干员生命值越低，攻击速度越快，30%生命值时达到最大可提升攻击速度（+60）
zh.flavor: 雷姆必拓当地矿场常用的一种针剂，强活性成分可以刺激工人的感官，保证其在极端环境下的工作效率。生命和工程都有期限，对他们而言，这仅仅是个选择题。

en.name: Old George's Nutri-Paste
en.effect: Operators gain ATK as their HP increases, up to +30% ATK at 100% HP
en.flavor: This poor-tasting fortified nutritional supplement was originally a 'dietary supplement' periodically provided to Columbian Pioneers, but after extensive marketing, it suddenly became a 'beauty product' beloved by nobles.

ja.name: 『オールドジョージ』栄養剤原液
ja.effect: オペレーターの残りHPの割合が高いほど、攻撃力が上昇（上昇最大値：HPが100%の時、攻撃力+30%）
ja.flavor: ひどい味の栄養剤。元はクルビアのデベロッパー企業が開拓者に提供していた「食糧」の補給だったのだが、怒涛の営業活動により、一変して貴族に愛される「良質な美容食品」と成り代わった。

zh.name: 古乔治营养原浆
zh.effect: 干员生命值越高，攻击力越高，100%生命值时达到最大可提升攻击力（+30%）
zh.flavor: 一种味道很差的强化营养剂，原本是哥伦比亚开发商定期向拓荒工人提供的“食物”补给，但在铺天盖地的营销后，它摇身一变成为了贵族钟爱的“美型良品”。

en.name: Broken Wand - Absorb
en.effect: Caster Operators recover 2 SP every time they deal damage to an enemy unit
en.flavor: Consume the defeated as nourishment, and embark on an eternal path to victory.

ja.name: 断杖・吸収
ja.effect: 【術師】がダメージを与えた時、攻撃対象1体につきSPが2回復
ja.flavor: 敗者の養分を取り込んで、永久不変の勝利へ踏み出す。

zh.name: 断杖-汲取
zh.effect: 所有【术师】干员每对一个单位造成伤害就回复2点技力值
zh.flavor: 摄取失败者的养分，踏上恒久的胜利。

en.name: Iron Guard - Advance
en.effect: Defender Operators inflict Bind on all nearby enemies lasting 1s every 2s, and deal True damage equal to 100% of their ATK
en.flavor: In exchange for an opportunity to attack, the shattered ranks made one more advance.

ja.name: 鉄衛・推進
ja.effect: 【重装】全員は2秒ごとに自身の近くにいる敵全員を1秒間バインド状態にし、攻撃力の100%の確定ダメージを与える
ja.flavor: 守りを捨てて攻撃の機会を掴み、破壊の戦列は猛進する。

zh.name: 铁卫-推进
zh.effect: 所有【重装】干员每2秒束缚自身附近所有敌人1秒，并造成相当于攻击力100%的真实伤害
zh.flavor: 以放弃防守换取进攻的机会，毁灭的阵线向前迈进。

en.name: Court Striking Block
en.effect: Allied Operators +10% HP for each Balance Coin in Coffer (max +150%)
en.flavor: The brother of a certain judge made this piece of wood for her so that she would have something to smash when annoyed by obstinate criminals, allowing her to vent her frustration while also intimidating the courtroom.

ja.name: 驚堂木
ja.effect: 銭匣内にある他の衡銭1枚につき、全てのオペレーターの最大HP+10%（最大+150%まで重複可能）
ja.flavor: 司法を担うとある役人は、言い逃ればかりの犯人に腹を立て、物を叩き壊そうとする衝動に駆られていた。そこで彼女の弟は、この木塊を発明した。これなら、鬱憤を晴らした上で容疑者を威圧できる。素晴らしい発明だ。

zh.name: 惊堂木
zh.effect: 钱盒里每有一枚衡钱，所有我方干员生命值+10％（最多+150％）
zh.flavor: 据说某位断案的官员常被胡搅蛮缠的犯人气得想砸东西，于是她的弟弟发明了这块木头，既能发泄不满，又能威慑公堂，甚妙。

en.name: Blaze's Chainsaw
en.effect: Enemies take increased damage from allied units as distance is reduced (max 100%)
en.flavor: She drags herself into hell with her enemies, appraising each other's determination with heat. She has never failed.

ja.name: Blazeのチェーンソー
ja.effect: 味方が敵を攻撃した際、攻撃対象との距離が近いほど与ダメージが上昇（最大100%まで）
ja.flavor: 彼女は敵を自分もろとも地獄へ引きずり込み、灼熱の炎によって互いの決意を見定める。彼女はこの勝負に敗れたことはない。

zh.name: Blaze的电锯
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到我方单位伤害时，距离伤害来源越近受到的伤害越高（最高100%）
zh.flavor: 她将自己与敌人一同拖入地狱，用炽热来鉴定彼此的决心。她从未失败。

en.name: Sawblade Bangle
en.effect: Operators have ATK +50% when blocking
en.flavor: Surprise is the key to victory in close quarters.

ja.name: 腕刃輪
ja.effect: オペレーターが敵をブロックしているとき、攻撃力+50%
ja.flavor: 白兵戦にて、奇策をもって勝利を収む。

zh.name: 手镯轮
zh.effect: 我方干员阻挡敌人时，攻击力+50％
zh.flavor: 短兵相接，出奇制胜。

en.name: Old Millstone
en.effect: Operators +6 ASPD after taking damage (Stacks 10x)
en.flavor: The beast that pulled the millstone was whipped, the man who pushed the millstone was berated, but it was the millstone that broke first. Now it turns by itself, whenever it hears a sound.

ja.name: 古びた石臼
ja.effect: 全てのオペレーターはダメージを受けるたび、攻撃速度+6（最大10回まで）
ja.flavor: 石臼を引く獣はいつも鞭打たれ、石臼を押す人はいつも罵倒されていたが、真っ先に限界を迎えたのは石臼の方だった。それ以来、石臼は物音を聞くだけで、ひとりでに回り出すようになったという。

zh.name: 老磨盘
zh.effect: 干员受到伤害后，攻击速度+6（最多叠加10次）
zh.flavor: 拉磨的兽总挨鞭子，推磨的人总受责骂，结果磨盘是最先崩溃的那个，此后，它但凡听见声响，就会自顾自地转起来。

en.name: Crowing Rooftop Figure
en.effect: Allied Operators gradually gain ASPD when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +40 after 40s; bonus is reset when skill ends
en.flavor: The rooftop figure's call announces the time at the Garden of Grotesqueries. The staff put a great deal of effort into it so it can take flight quickly and let out a cry that reaches every corner of the garden.

ja.name: 鳴脊獣
ja.effect: 全てのオペレーターはスキル未発動の間、攻撃速度が+40まで徐々に上昇していく（最大値になるまでの時間は40秒）。スキル終了時、効果はリセットされる
ja.flavor: この脊獣は界園全体に時を告げる役目を担っている。職員は脊獣を速やかに飛び立たせ、ひと鳴きで界園に時報を響かせることに多大な労力を費やした。

zh.name: 鸣脊兽
zh.effect: 所有我方干员技能未开启时40秒内攻击速度逐渐提升至至高+40，每次技能结束时失去该加成
zh.flavor: 这只脊兽负责给整个界园报时，工作人员在它身上花了许多心思，就为了让它快快起飞，一鸣惊园。

en.name: Heaven Axe
en.effect: Operators +60% ATK and HP, but -30% ATK and HP whenever you enter Sui's Remnant Consciousness (Stacks 2x)
en.flavor: A lumberjack who lost his way in the Garden of Grotesqueries managed to cut a way through to Jianzi Shrine with nothing more than a blunt axe and sheer force of will. This old fellow, who hadn't the faintest idea what consciousness of the Sui even was, was later 'hired' as a staff member, and Yi added the axe he no longer needed to his collection.

ja.name: 登天の斧
ja.effect: 全てのオペレーターの攻撃力・最大HP+60%。【歳獣の残識】に入るたび、全てのオペレーターの攻撃力・最大HP-30%（最大2回まで重複可能）
ja.flavor: かつて一人の木こりが界園に迷い込んだ。彼はなまくらの斧と生きたいという執念だけで、山の麓から見字祠の門前まで道を切り開いた。その後、歳獣の残識を知らない老人は界園の職員として「採用」され、イーは彼が使わなくなった斧をコレクションに加えた。

zh.name: 登天斧
zh.effect: 所有干员攻击力、生命值+60％。每进入一次岁兽残识，所有干员攻击力、生命值-30％（最多叠加2次）
zh.flavor: 曾有樵夫迷失于界园，凭着一把钝斧头和求生欲从山脚一路砍到了见字祠的大门前。之后这位不知岁识为何物的大爷便被“聘”为界园的工作人员，而易则收藏了他再也用不到的斧头。

en.name: Yarn of Real and Unreal
en.effect: Operator DEF +600 and RES +15 when there are other Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles
en.flavor: Yarn that Yi collected, which Ji is loath to use. After the real and unreal threads were tidied up, it was tossed into a corner of the Garden of Grotesqueries for the beasts to toy with.

ja.name: 虚実の糸玉
ja.effect: 味方の周囲8マス内に他のオペレーターがいる場合、自身の防御力+600、術耐性+15
ja.flavor: ジーが不要と言って捨てた糸を、イーがどこからともなく集めてきたもの。虚なる線と実なる線の双方に一通りの手が加えられた後、界園の片隅に投げ込まれ、獣たちの遊び道具となった。

zh.name: 虚实线团
zh.effect: 干员周围八格内有其他干员时，自身防御力+600，法术抗性+15
zh.flavor: 易不知从何处收集来的，绩弃之不用的丝线，在虚线与实线都经过一番处理后，它们被丢入界园一隅，成了野兽们的玩具。

en.name: Silk Knot
en.effect: Operator Max HP +40% when there are other Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles
en.flavor: Yi's wedding gift to a staff couple, made to unravel when either is unfaithful. The couple left a long time ago, but nothing has changed with the knot.

ja.name: 絹の錠
ja.effect: 味方の周囲8マス内に他のオペレーターがいる場合、自身の最大HP+40%
ja.flavor: イーが古株の職員同士の結婚立会人を務めた際に贈ったもの。どちらかの心が離れてしまえば、この絹の錠はひとりでに解けるのだが、彼らがここを去って久しい今もなおその気配はない。

zh.name: 绸锁
zh.effect: 干员周围八格内有其他干员时，自身最大生命值上限+40％
zh.flavor: 易为一对老员工证婚时送上的礼物，若是有人变心，这把绸锁就会自己解开——他们已经离开很久了，这把锁似乎仍没有什么变化。

en.name: Fragment of Ju's Order
en.effect: Operator ATK +50%, bonus lost when skill is activated manually
en.flavor: A piece of Ju's strange body, now part of the Baizao Museum collection. It was withdrawn from display and put into storage after a group of tourists marched out of the exhibition hall in perfect unison after viewing it.

ja.name: 循矩の残滓
ja.effect: オペレーターの攻撃力+50%、手動でスキルを発動したオペレーターは効果を失う
ja.flavor: 矩獣の異様な体の一部であり、現在は百灶博物館に所蔵されている。以前この収蔵品を見学した一行が、不可解にも一糸乱れぬ様子で足並みを揃え、展示室を退出するという出来事があったため、この展示品は直ちに倉庫へ移され、展示禁止の処置が取られた。

zh.name: 循矩残片
zh.effect: 干员攻击力+50％，手动开启技能后对应干员失去加成
zh.flavor: 矩兽怪异身躯的一部分，如今藏于百灶博物馆。过去，有一组参观过该藏品的游客莫名迈着整齐划一的步伐走出展厅，这件物品随即被运入库房，永不展出。

en.name: Fragment of Hou's Soil
en.effect: When an Operator on a Vagary Tile uses a skill, all Operators +40% ATK for 30s
en.flavor: A piece of Hou's heavy body, once part of the Baizao Museum collection. It disappeared when the exhibition hall turned into a garden; perhaps the Feranmut has already become one with this newborn corner of nature.

ja.name: 後土の残滓
ja.effect: 化境マスにいるオペレーターがスキルを発動すると、30秒間、全てのオペレーターの攻撃力+40%
ja.flavor: 後獣の巨大な体の一部であり、かつては百灶博物館に所蔵されていた。しかし、展示場全体を庭園へと変貌させると、忽然と姿を消してしまった。もしかすると、展示場に新たに生まれた自然と一体化したのかもしれない。

zh.name: 后土残片
zh.effect: 位于化境地块上的干员开启技能时，使全场干员攻击力+40％，持续30秒
zh.flavor: 后兽沉重身躯的一部分，曾藏于百灶博物馆内。在将整个展馆化作花园后不知所终，或许祂已同这片新生的自然融为一体。

en.name: Victory Guqin
en.effect: Allied Operators' ATK +15%, extra +5% whenever Life Point(s) lost (Stacks 17x)
en.flavor: Only a brave warrior who came back from battle can make a sound with it. Each battle forms a music score that is preserved for commemoration. The body of the zither is red after hundreds of battles, but the music of victory lingers.

ja.name: 勝利の琴
ja.effect: 全てのオペレーターの攻撃力+15%。耐久値が減少するたび、攻撃力が追加で+5%（最大17回まで重複可能）
ja.flavor: 戦場から凱旋した勇士のみが奏でることを許された琴。戦のたびに記念として楽譜が一つ刻まれていく。百戦を経て、琴の胴は真っ赤に染まったが、勝利の音色は今なお耳に残り続ける。

zh.name: 得胜琴
zh.effect: 我方干员攻击力+15％。每次损失目标生命值时，攻击力额外+5％（最多叠加17次）
zh.flavor: 只有征战归来的勇士才能拨上一个音，一战之后，便得一谱，收为纪念。经历百战，琴体早已被染红。但得胜之音，绕耳不息。

en.name: 'Panacea'
en.effect: Operator +1200 DEF and +30 RES when affected by negative status (Cold, Frozen, Stun)
en.flavor: The doctor developed this recipe to soothe the patient's pain and anxiety, giving them more time to tackle the root of the ailment. However, patients often believe it to be a miracle cure because it makes their pain vanish.

ja.name: 「万霊の処方」
ja.effect: 状態異常（寒冷/凍結/スタン）中の味方の防御力+1200、術耐性+30
ja.flavor: この処方を開発した若い医者は、痛みを和らげ、心を落ち着かせることで、医師による治療までの時間を稼ぐためのものに過ぎないと言っていた。だが、多くの人は痛みが消えたことで完治したと思い込み、この処方を実態にそぐわない名で呼んだ。

zh.name: “万灵方”
zh.effect: 干员位于异常状态（寒冷、冰冻、晕眩）时，防御力+1200、法术抗性+30
zh.flavor: 研发这药方的小郎中说它只可缓解疼痛，凝神安心，为医生对症下药争取时间。但许多人不疼了就以为是药到病除，便给这帖药安了这么个虚名。

en.name: Waking Tower
en.effect: Awakens an Hour of Sui
en.flavor: The Hour of Sui is inexorable, but Liu'er came up with this tower that changes the Hour of Sui, with the help of the Sui proxies.

ja.name: 醒覚の塔
ja.effect: 歳時を1つ醒覚状態にする
ja.flavor: 歳時には抗い難いが、リューは妙案をひらめいた。そうして彼女は、歳獣の代理人たちの助けを借り、歳時を改めることのできるこの宝塔を作り上げたのだった。

zh.name: 醒时塔
zh.effect: 醒觉一个岁时
zh.flavor: 岁时难抗，但柳儿想了个绝妙的法子。在诸位岁兽代理人的帮助下，她研究出了这座能改换岁时的宝塔。

en.name: Coin Platter
en.effect: +1 Hope on Flower Coin toss; +4 Ingots on Balance Coin toss; +1 Life Point on Risk Coin toss
en.flavor: If you are going to toss a coin, it had better make a sound. Created for such a purpose, this plate has somehow become one of the most discerning coin connoisseurs in the land.

ja.name: 銭受けの皿
ja.effect: 花銭が振り出されると、希望+1。衡銭が振り出されると、源石錐+4。厲銭が振り出されると、耐久値を1回復
ja.flavor: 振り銭をする以上、チャリンと音が鳴らなければ気が済まないとして、物好きがわざわざ皿を作り、「投げるものあれば、受けるものあり」などともっともらしいことを言っていた。後にその皿は、いつの間にかこの大地きっての銭を見分ける逸品に育っていたという。

zh.name: 承钱盘
zh.effect: 投出花钱时，希望+1；投出衡钱时，源石锭+4；投出厉钱时，目标生命值+1
zh.flavor: 投钱就要听个叮当响，有好事者为此专门做了个盘子，还美其名曰“一个要摔，一个要挨”。不知不觉间，竟培养出这大地上一等一的识钱好盘。

en.name: Little Ba'jie Sticker
en.effect: Chance to toss extra Tongbao
en.flavor: Sticker of the Garden of Grotesqueries mascot, often sold in a set with Tongbao. Sometimes throws out its friends that want to leave the Coin Coffer.

ja.name: 八界くんシール
ja.effect: 一定確率で通宝が追加で振り出される
ja.flavor: よく通宝と一緒に売り出されている界園のマスコットのシールだが、木の銭匣から離れようとする友人たちをふっ飛ばしてしまうこともある。

zh.name: 小八界贴纸
zh.effect: 有概率额外投出通宝
zh.flavor: 时常与通宝一起被出售的界园吉祥物贴纸，偶尔会将想要离开藏钱木盒的好朋友们掷出去。

en.name: Soldier's Edge
en.effect: Allied Operators +10% ATK for each Balance Coin in Coffer (max +150%)
en.flavor: Every member of the Imperial Guard is the product of both skill and luck. The same is true of their weapons.

ja.name: 兵鋒
ja.effect: 銭匣内にある他の衡銭1枚につき、全てのオペレーターの攻撃力+10%（最大+150%まで重複可能）
ja.flavor: 禁軍の兵は皆、実力と気運が生み出した偶然の産物である。彼らが使う武器もまた然り。

zh.name: 兵锋
zh.effect: 钱盒里每有一枚衡钱，所有我方干员攻击力+10％（最多+150％）
zh.flavor: 每一位禁军都是实力与气运造就的偶然，其兵刃同样如此。

en.name: King's New Lance
en.effect: All allied Operators have +50 ASPD when at 1 Life Point
en.flavor: Beautiful wishes made in dire straits can bring hope, even if they are not necessarily the truth.

ja.name: 王様の新しき槍
ja.effect: 耐久値が1の場合、全てのオペレーターの攻撃速度+50
ja.flavor: 絶体絶命な状況において、祈りは人々に希望をもたらす。たとえそれが現実から遠くかけ離れていようとも。

zh.name: 国王的新枪
zh.effect: 目标生命为1时，所有我方干员的攻击速度+50
zh.flavor: 绝境下的美好祈愿能带给人希望，即使那并不是真相。

en.name: King's Armor
en.effect: +3 Objective Shield, coverts all Life Points into Objective Shield, and -1 Life Point and +1 Objective Shield at the end of battle
en.flavor: There used to be many golden display cases placed before the palace gates and in the square, displaying all sorts of treasures to admire. But now, it hurts just to think about such sights.

ja.name: 王様の甲冑
ja.effect: シールド値+3、全ての耐久値を同量のシールド値に変換し、戦闘終了時に耐久値-1、シールド値+1
ja.flavor: かつて王宮の門前や広場には、金色に輝くショーケースがいくつも並んでおり、その中には鑑賞用に各地から集められた宝が置かれていた。しかし今では、その場面を思い返すだけで心が痛む。

zh.name: 国王的铠甲
zh.effect: 护盾值+3，将目标生命全部转化为等量护盾值且战斗结束后使目标生命-1，护盾值+1
zh.flavor: 王宫的大门前、广场上，曾摆放着那么多金色的展柜，四方珍品尽供欣赏。而现在，仅仅是回想那个场面就会让人受伤。

en.name: King's Legacy
en.effect: When at 1 Life Point, all Operators recover additional 1 SP and 3% of Max HP every 2s
en.flavor: Grow up and face reality. Arm yourself with tenacity and confidence, while showing your friends tolerance and grace.

ja.name: 王様の延伸
ja.effect: 耐久値が1の場合、全てのオペレーターが2秒ごとにSPを追加で1回復し、HPを最大値の3%回復
ja.flavor: 成長し、現実を見定めて、剛毅な心と堅い意志を以て己が武装とし、包容と慈悲を以て友の武装とせよ。

zh.name: 国王的延伸
zh.effect: 目标生命为1时，所有干员每2秒额外回复1点技力和3%的生命值
zh.flavor: 成长，认清现实，用坚韧与笃定武装自己，用包容与慈恩武装朋友。

en.name: King's Crown
en.effect: All Operators gain +40% ATK when at 1 Life Point, or +80% if you have 3 or more King's Collectibles
en.flavor: O Nameless Kings, may you continue to bless Iberia, even though your kingdoms are no more.

ja.name: 諸王の冠
ja.effect: 耐久値が1の場合、全てのオペレーターの攻撃力+40%（王様の秘宝を3つ以上所持している場合、上昇量が+80%になる）
ja.flavor: 名もなき諸王よ、たとえ王国が滅びようとも、変わらずイベリアを守りたまえ。

zh.name: 诸王的冠冕
zh.effect: 目标生命为1时，所有我方干员的攻击力+40%，集齐3件及以上国王收藏品后变为+80%
zh.flavor: 无名的诸王啊，纵使王国毁灭，仍愿您护佑伊比利亚。

en.name: Sarkaz King's Regal Rest
en.effect: All Operators gain +20% DEF and +10 RES when at full Life Points
en.flavor: For those in this position, a peaceful sleep becomes eternal

ja.name: 魔王の寝台
ja.effect: 耐久値が上限に達している場合、全てのオペレーターの防御力+20%、術耐性+10
ja.flavor: この王位に身を置けば、その安眠は永眠となる。

zh.name: 魔王的床榻
zh.effect: 目标生命值达到上限时，所有干员的防御力+20%，法术抗性+10
zh.flavor: 身居此位者，安睡即为永眠。

en.name: Sarkaz King's Torn Banner
en.effect: All Operators gain +50 ASPD when at full Life Points
en.flavor: For those in this position, to struggle is to inevitably fall.

ja.name: 魔王の御旗
ja.effect: 耐久値が上限に達している場合、全てのオペレーターの攻撃速度+50
ja.flavor: この王位に身を置けば、抗ったとて落命は避けられぬ。

zh.name: 魔王的旗帜
zh.effect: 目标生命值达到上限时，所有干员的攻击速度+50
zh.flavor: 身居此位者，抗争便会陨落。

en.name: King of Sarkaz's Vessel
en.effect: All Operators gain +60% Max HP when at full Life Points, or +120% if you have collected 3 or more King of Sarkaz's Collectibles
en.flavor: For those in this position, prosperity is but an illusion.

ja.name: 魔王の祭器
ja.effect: 耐久値が上限に達している場合、全てのオペレーターの最大HP+60%（魔王の秘宝を3つ以上所持している場合、上昇量が+120%になる）
ja.flavor: この王位に身を置く者にとって、繁栄は泡沫のように散るが定め。

zh.name: 魔王的祭器
zh.effect: 目标生命值达到上限时，所有干员的最大生命值+60%，集齐3件及以上魔王收藏品后变为+120%
zh.flavor: 身居此位者，兴盛仅是泡影。

en.name: Hand of Buckler
en.effect: Decel Binder, Hexer, and Abjurer Operators' attacks deal additional Arts damage equal to 3% of the target's current HP
en.flavor: Drop by drop, bit by bit. It is unstoppable.

ja.name: 藻掻く手
ja.effect: 【緩速師】・【呪詛師】・【祈祷師】は攻撃時、追加で攻撃対象の残りHPの3%にあたる術ダメージを与える
ja.flavor: ぽたりぽたり、雨垂れが石を穿つ。

zh.name: 扣挠之手
zh.effect: 【凝滞师】【削弱者】【护佑者】攻击时额外造成目标当前生命值3%的法术伤害
zh.flavor: 点点滴滴，挡无可挡。

en.name: Hand of Predation
en.effect: Pioneer, Charger, and Tactician Operators gain +10% ATK and DEF on every skill activation (Stacks 10x)
en.flavor: Herds stir, flesh rend asunder.

ja.name: 捕食の手
ja.effect: 【先駆兵】・【突撃兵】・【戦術家】はスキルを発動するたび、自身の攻撃力・防御力+10%（最大10回まで）
ja.flavor: 獣の群れへと飛び込んで、その皮を引き裂く。

zh.name: 掠食之手
zh.effect: 【尖兵】【冲锋手】【战术家】每次开启技能时自身攻击力、防御力+10%（最多叠加10层）
zh.flavor: 跃入兽群，撕裂皮囊。

en.name: Hand of Rending
en.effect: Reaper, Soloblade, and Fighter Operators ignore 70% of the target's DEF
en.flavor: Mountains shatter, stones devoured.

ja.name: 砕岩の手
ja.effect: 【鎌撃士】・【武者】・【闘士】の攻撃が対象の防御を70%無視
ja.flavor: 山を割り地を砕き、土を食らい石を呑み込め。

zh.name: 裂岩之手
zh.effect: 【收割者】【武者】【斗士】攻击无视目标70%防御
zh.flavor: 开山碎地，噬土吞石。

en.name: Hand of Undulation
en.effect: Splash Caster, Chain Caster, and Mech-accord Caster Operators recover 2 SP each time they deal damage to an enemy unit
en.flavor: Blasts conquer, the wake deafening.

ja.name: 波紋の手
ja.effect: 【拡散術師】・【連鎖術師】・【操機術師】がダメージを与えた時、攻撃対象1体につきSPが2回復
ja.flavor: ひとたび過れば、轟きが鼓膜を震わす。

zh.name: 波纹之手
zh.effect: 【扩散术师】【链术师】【驭械术师】每对一个单位造成伤害就回复2点技力值
zh.flavor: 一扫而过，震耳欲聋。

en.name: Hand of Protraction
en.effect: Ambusher, Merchant, and Geek Operators gain +25% ATK for every 30s they remain on the battlefield (Stacks 5x)
en.flavor: Protracted battles, a home of carnage.

ja.name: 長居の手
ja.effect: 【潜伏者】・【行商人】・【鬼才】は配置中、30秒ごとに攻撃力+25%（最大5回まで）
ja.flavor: 戦場は我が家の如し、長くこの地に定住す。

zh.name: 久居之手
zh.effect: 【伏击客】【行商】【怪杰】每在场上存在30秒，攻击力+25%（最多叠加5层）
zh.flavor: 战场如家，久居常住。

en.name: Hand of Fireworks
en.effect: Marksman, Loopshooter, and Sentry Protector Operators have a 25% chance when an attack hits to shoot an extra projectile, dealing 200% ATK as AoE Physical Damage
en.flavor: Bang! Boom! A pleasant surprise.

ja.name: 花火の手
ja.effect: 【速射手】・【旋輪射手】・【哨戒衛士】が敵にダメージを与えるたび、25%の確率で追加の弾を1発発射し、攻撃力の200%の範囲物理ダメージを与える
ja.flavor: ヒュルルル、ドーン。思いがけないサプライズだ。

zh.name: 烟花之手
zh.effect: 【速射手】【回环射手】【哨戒铁卫】每次攻击命中时，有25%概率发射一枚额外子弹，造成相当于攻击力200%的群体物理伤害
zh.flavor: 砰砰啪啪，意外之喜。

en.name: Featured Canned Meat
en.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, all allied units recover 3 HP per second
en.flavor: For travelers on a long journey, the convenience of 'ready to eat' is often more important than taste.

zh.name: 精选兽肉罐头
zh.effect: 可携带干员+1，所有我方单位每秒回复3点生命
zh.flavor: 对奔行于长路的旅人而言，“开罐即食”的便利，往往比味道更重要。

en.name: Seaweed Salad
en.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, all allied units gain +1 ASPD
en.flavor: Once a beloved Iberian delicacy, now fading from memory due to the rampaging Seaborn.

zh.name: 凉拌海草
zh.effect: 可携带干员+1，所有我方单位的攻击速度+1
zh.flavor: 曾是令伊比利亚人自傲的民族美食，如今已因海嗣横行，渐渐离开了人们的记忆。

en.name: Orange Storm
en.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, all allied units gain +1% ATK
en.flavor: A Mama John's candy. The orange flavor, cheap and delicious, is a best-seller among children.

zh.name: 橙味风暴
zh.effect: 可携带干员+1，所有我方单位的攻击力+1%
zh.flavor: 约翰老妈糖果产品，畅销橙子味，以廉价美味为卖点，在孩子中很有人气。

en.name: Screaming Cherry
en.effect: Squad Size Limit +2, all allied units gain +2% ATK
en.flavor: A Mama John's candy. Though the niche vinegar-pickled cherry flavor can't compete with the best-sellers in popularity, it has garnered a small group of loyal supporters. Rumor has it that one of Mama John's directors loves this flavor.

zh.name: 尖叫樱桃
zh.effect: 可携带干员+2，所有我方单位的攻击力+2%
zh.flavor: 约翰老妈糖果产品，小众醋腌樱桃味，销量无法比肩畅销款，但一直有一小群忠实而稳定的消费者。听说某位约翰老妈董事就钟爱此口味。

en.name: Coffee Plains Coffee Candy
en.effect: Squad Size Limit +2, all allied units gain +2 ASPD
en.flavor: Dossoles' famous coffee-flavored candy product. Has real caffeine added, to keep you wide awake from clock-in to overtime.

zh.name: 咖啡平原咖啡糖
zh.effect: 可携带干员+2，所有我方单位的攻击速度+2
zh.flavor: 多索雷斯咖啡品牌糖果产品，现已广销各地。添加真实咖啡因，让你从上班清醒到加班。

en.name: Pitt's Assorted Fruits
en.effect: Squad Size Limit +3, all allied units gain +3% ATK, DEF, and HP
en.flavor: With rich taste and affordable prices, Pitt's assorted fruit candies rival Mama John's in the sweets market. Muelsyse's favorite.

zh.name: 皮特水果什锦
zh.effect: 可携带干员+3，所有我方单位的攻击力、防御力和生命值+3%
zh.flavor: 皮特牌什锦水果糖，以丰富的口味和超高性价比在糖果市场上与约翰老妈糖果系列相抗衡。缪尔赛思的最爱。

en.name: Topographical Map
en.effect: Deployment Limit +1, all allied units gain +4% DEF
en.flavor: A hand-drawn map exuding antiquity. The labels and terrain are enlarged, and its scale seems to be off.

zh.name: 地形图
zh.effect: 可同时部署人数+1，所有我方单位的防御力+4%
zh.flavor: 一份颇有年代感的手绘地图，图上的名称和对应地形都有较大更易，比例尺似乎也有些问题。

en.name: Conch of Divine Whispers
en.effect: Deployment Limit +1, all allied units gain +4% HP
en.flavor: Sound it, and gods you've never seen or even heard of will answer your call. Actually, it's just a hollow conch shell.

zh.name: 神音海螺
zh.effect: 可同时部署人数+1，所有我方单位的生命值+4%
zh.flavor: 吹响它，那些你不曾见过、甚至不曾听闻的神明将回应你的声音。其实就是一个空心海螺。

en.name: Night-Whispers in the Forest
en.effect: Deployment Limit +2, all allied units gain +6% DEF
en.flavor: A Convalescent Garden aromatherapy set for field operators, featuring fifteen herbal extracts in a hundred and seventy-two combinations. Said to evoke the soothing sense of rustling leaves and gentle chirping.

zh.name: 林间夜话
zh.effect: 可同时部署人数+2，所有我方单位的防御力+6%
zh.flavor: 疗养庭院为有外勤任务的干员特调的香薰套装，提炼十五种植物成分，尝试一百七十二种组合。风踏进山林，万物低语，人可好眠。

en.name: Church Alms Meal Voucher
en.effect: Deployment Limit +2, all allied units gain +6% HP
en.flavor: In the declining coastal towns of Iberia, certain churches will provide alms in the form of meals, which their believers can redeem using vouchers. As for how these vouchers are distributed, that is a secret.

zh.name: 教堂救济餐券
zh.effect: 可同时部署人数+2，所有我方单位的生命值+6%
zh.flavor: 在没落的伊比利亚沿海城镇，某些教堂会定期提供救济餐，信徒们凭券领取。至于救济餐券的发放标准，是个秘密。

en.name: Antiquated Sheet Music
en.effect: Hope +4
en.flavor: A tattered piece of sheet music. The notes can no longer be clearly read. No one knows for certain what story this piece was meant to tell.

zh.name: 古旧乐谱残章
zh.effect: 希望+4
zh.flavor: 一张古旧的乐谱残章，上面的音符已经模糊不清，不知这首曲子讲述着怎样的故事。

en.name: Letter of Termination Contract
en.effect: Hope +4
en.flavor: You can break free from this troupe with just one signature.

zh.name: 解约协议
zh.effect: 希望+4
zh.flavor: 只要拿到一个签名，就可以彻底摆脱这个剧团了。

en.name: Banshee's Kiss
en.effect: Hope +8
en.flavor: Outbloods show exceptional courage when in possession of this trinket, but to Logos, a rare male Banshee, it's just a common object.

zh.name: 女妖之吻
zh.effect: 希望+8
zh.flavor: 外族人获得它时常常会展现出超越自身的勇气，但作为稀少的男性女妖，Logos对于这种东西已经见怪不怪了。

en.name: Hot Water Kettle
en.effect: +2 Max Life Points, Hope +2
en.flavor: Some people often use the hot water kettle in the Rhodes Island Office to cook instant noodles in the middle of the night. That's not a very healthy lifestyle...

zh.name: 热水壶
zh.effect: 目标生命上限+2，希望+2
zh.flavor: 罗德岛办公室里的同款热水壶，有人经常大半夜用热水壶煮速食面吃，这种生活习惯不是很健康......

en.name: Extra-Pungent Coffee Beans
en.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1, +1 Objective Shield
en.flavor: Coffee beans fed to a rare, peculiar-smelling fowlbeast and processed from its excrement. The unique aroma from gastric acid fermentation triples the beans' price.

zh.name: 特级馥郁咖啡豆
zh.effect: 可携带干员+1，可同时部署人数+1，护盾值+1
zh.flavor: 咖啡农们喂某类体带异香的珍稀羽兽吃下咖啡豆，再从其排泄物中提取加工，经过胃酸发酵过程产生的异香，让咖啡豆的价格翻了三倍。

en.name: Blue Silk Scarf
en.effect: Hope +2, Squad Size Limit +1
en.flavor: A lady's elegant scarf. Her appearance is a sign that it is safe here.

zh.name: 蓝色丝巾
zh.effect: 希望+2，可携带干员+1
zh.flavor: 女士优雅的丝巾，她的出现代表安全。

en.name: Red Bow Tie
en.effect: Hope +2, Deployment Limit +1
en.flavor: The first present Phantom gave Miss.Christine. She is really fond of it.

zh.name: 红色蝴蝶结
zh.effect: 希望+2，可同时部署人数+1
zh.flavor: 傀影送出的第一份礼物，Miss.Christine非常中意。

en.name: Solo Music Box
en.effect: Hope +4, Deployment Limit +1
en.flavor: An old music box. The music does not play when the box is opened, nor does the figure inside show any signs it is about to move. There is not a peep, and no one is breaking out in dance. Before she begins her performances with Phantom, the lead actress stares blankly into the music box.

zh.name: 独奏八音盒
zh.effect: 希望+4，可同时部署人数+1
zh.flavor: 老旧的八音盒，打开之后音乐没有响起，盒子中央的小人也没有动。没有任何响动，无人跳舞。在与傀影对戏之前，女主演总是在后台痴痴地看着它。

en.name: Originium Iris
en.effect: Hope +6, Squad Size Limit +2
en.flavor: A most extravagant bouquet of flowers. The troupe leader has handed flowers like these to the leads during countless curtain calls.
en.unlock: Complete an ending with at least 60 Max Hope

zh.name: 源石鸢尾花
zh.effect: 希望+6，可携带干员+2
zh.flavor: 极尽奢华的花朵，剧团长在谢幕时向主演献花的次数寥寥无几。
zh.unlock: 拥有不小于60点以上希望上限时完成游戏结局

en.name: Weird Flute
en.effect: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1
en.flavor: A weird-looking flute. Someone plays it day in and day out.

zh.name: 古怪的长笛
zh.effect: 希望+4，可携带干员+1
zh.flavor: 外形古怪的长笛，有人日夜将其吹响。

en.name: Glass Bird
en.effect: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1
en.flavor: 'In this paradise of mine, the bird will sing forever and ever.'
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 50 Hope.

zh.name: 玻璃小鸟
zh.effect: 希望+4，可携带干员+1
zh.flavor: “在我的乐园里，这只小鸟会永远地歌唱下去。”
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计获得50希望

en.name: Pure Gold Expedition
en.effect: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1
en.flavor: The regent departed from the wastelands, and markets rose from beneath her dress like sprouts budding in the spring. The road of prosperity connected high mountains and dense forests, following her until she disappeared beyond the cliffs overlooking the western waves. —Ancient Sargon Fairy Tale
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 150 Hope

zh.name: 赤金的远征
zh.effect: 希望+4，可携带干员+1，可同时部署人数+1
zh.flavor: 君王自荒地出发，集市在她的裙下如春芽萌发，财富之路连通高山密林，直到她消失在西方浪涛的边崖。——萨尔贡古老童话
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计获得150希望

en.name: 'Durin Overground'
en.effect: Shield +4
en.flavor: In this expedition account, we get a glimpse of how those who live underground see those who live on the surface.
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 50 Life Points

zh.name: 《杜林地上环游记》
zh.effect: 护盾值+4
zh.flavor: 从这本游记中，我们可以一窥地底人对于地表人的奇异见解。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计损失50目标生命

en.name: 'Gaulish Toponym Origins'
en.effect: +6 Objective Shield
en.flavor: A book of historical place names that Mint dug out of the Doctor's office. Calais-Blason is mentioned in the book.
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Life Points

zh.name: 《旧高卢地名源流考》
zh.effect: 护盾值+6
zh.flavor: 薄绿从博士办公室里翻出来的古地名历史书，里面记载有克莱布拉松。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计损失125目标生命

en.name: Supreme Ring
en.effect: +50% Originium Ingot drops from battle
en.flavor: In Leithanian mythology, he who holds the ring enjoys the vast riches of the entire world, but greed will also be his undoing.
en.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 30 Originium Ingots remaining

zh.name: 至宝指环
zh.effect: 战斗掉落的源石锭+50%
zh.flavor: 在莱塔尼亚的神话中，持戒者享有整片大地的财富，但也终将因贪婪毁灭。
zh.unlock: 剩余不小于30源石锭时完成游戏结局

en.name: Victorian 'Scrap' Medal
en.effect: Gain +20% Command EXP from battles
en.flavor: A knight's medal that Siege threw together and awarded to Dagda on the spot. The materials used are pitiful, but it holds a lot of meaning to Dagda.

zh.name: 维多利亚“废铁”勋章
zh.effect: 战斗获得的指挥经验+20%
zh.flavor: 推进之王临时设计并颁发给达格达的骑士勋章。材料很烂，但对达格达来说很有意义。

en.name: Lost Key
en.effect: Command EXP gained from battles +30%; immediately gain 50 Originium Ingots upon reaching Command Level 10
en.flavor: 'Fellas, this key can open the treasure trove lost within the royal city of Kazdel. Hey, green-haired Feline! Watch that hooded slave of yours and keep those hands away from my map!'
en.unlock: Reach an ending 3 times

zh.name: 失落之钥
zh.effect: 战斗获得的指挥经验+30%，指挥等级到达10级时，立刻获得50源石锭
zh.flavor: “伙计们，这把钥匙能够打开失落王都卡兹戴尔的宝库。喂，绿发的菲林，看好你的兜帽奴隶，别让他碰我的地图！”
zh.unlock: 通关结局3次

en.name: Special Suppressor
en.effect: +2 Max Life Points, recover 2 Life Points
en.flavor: An enhanced suppressor developed by Rhodes Island that can better keep the Infected from losing control of their Originium Arts.

zh.name: 特殊抑制器
zh.effect: 目标生命上限+2，回复2目标生命
zh.flavor: 罗德岛改良款抑制器，能够有效遏制感染造成的源石技艺失控。

en.name: Acahuallan Bowl
en.effect: Restore 4 Life Points, +2 Objective Shield
en.flavor: Fruit is one of the locals' staples, often eaten fresh right off the tree.

zh.name: 阿卡胡拉饭碗
zh.effect: 回复4目标生命，护盾值+2
zh.flavor: 水果是当地人的主食之一，现采现食也是常有的事。

en.name: Vampire's Bed
en.effect: +4 Max Life Points
en.flavor: A lavish-looking coffin that matches the castle's aesthetics well. However, Warfarin says this is merely a stereotype.

zh.name: 血魔的寝床
zh.effect: 目标生命上限+4
zh.flavor: 一副奢华的棺木，和古堡十分般配，华法琳说这就是刻板印象。

en.name: Proof of Longevity
en.effect: +6 Max Life Points
en.flavor:
A tree branch that has withered and flourished.
When it is withered, it grows anew. When it is thriving in its fullest, it fades away yet again.
en.unlock: Clear the first floor [Bolivarian Skin Layer]

zh.name: 长生者之证
zh.effect: 目标生命上限+6
zh.flavor:
一段树枝，枯荣一体；
从枯萎处生长，从繁盛处枯萎。
zh.unlock: 通过第一层【玻利瓦尔肤层】

en.name: Swaddled Pegasus
en.effect: Starting Action Points +1 each time you enter a new Area
en.flavor: May it, newly born, never again have its wings broken.

zh.name: 襁褓天马
zh.effect: 每次进入新区域时，初始行动力+1
zh.flavor: 愿新生的它不再折翼。

en.name: Swaddled Hippogriff
en.effect: Starting Hope +1, and all node information in the first two exploration Areas is revealed from the start
en.flavor: May it, newly born, never again be arrogant.

zh.name: 襁褓骏鹰
zh.effect: 初始希望+1，初始揭示前两个探索区域中所有节点的信息
zh.flavor: 愿新生的它不再狂傲。

en.name: Swaddled Dragon
en.effect: In battles in the first two exploration Areas, all enemies have -50% Max HP
en.flavor: May it, newly born, never again go hungry.

zh.name: 襁褓巨龙
zh.effect: 前两个探索区域的战斗中，所有敌人的最大生命-50%
zh.flavor: 愿新生的它不再饥饿。

en.name: Swaddled Hydra
en.effect: All enemies gain +30% ATK and Max HP; each time you enter a new Area, allied units gain +10% ATK and Max HP
en.flavor: May it, newly born, never again know pain.

zh.name: 襁褓九头蛇
zh.effect: 所有敌人的攻击和生命+30%，每进入新区域时我方攻击力和生命+10%
zh.flavor: 愿新生的它不再痛苦。

en.name: Swaddled Baize
en.effect: Increases the chance of Temporary Recruitment when recruiting Operators
en.flavor: May it, newly born, never again be lonely.

zh.name: 襁褓白泽
zh.effect: 干员招募时，出现临时招募的概率提升
zh.flavor: 愿新生的它不再孤独。

en.name: Swaddled Golden Crow
en.effect: Gain 3 random collectibles upon entering Area III, the Crimson Hollow Vein
en.flavor: May it, newly born, never again fall.

zh.name: 襁褓金乌
zh.effect: 进入区域Ⅲ血色空脉时，获得3个随机收藏品
zh.flavor: 愿新生的它不再陨落。

en.name: Vanilla Soda
en.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s
en.flavor: Bolívar's cheap specialty drink dates back hundreds of years. It is mixed with a variety of spices, and is known for not being very good.

zh.name: 香草沙士汽水
zh.effect: 所有自然回复技能的技力恢复+0.2/秒
zh.flavor: 玻利瓦尔本地的廉价饮料，拥有上百年历史，混合多种香料，特点是不好喝。

en.name: Fowlbeast Liver Pate
en.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.35/s
en.flavor: A small jar of fowlbeast liver pâté. Bright and vividly colorful, it is eaten only by nobles.

zh.name: 羽兽肝酱
zh.effect: 所有自然回复技能的技力恢复+0.35/秒
zh.flavor: 小瓶高档羽兽肝酱，颜色鲜艳，贵族特供。

en.name: Dreaming Essence
en.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.5/s
en.flavor: Supposedly the Banshees make their aromatics only for their beloved. A single drop is enough to enchant just about anyone, bringing out any artist's inspiration and creativity.
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader [Elbert] a total of 2 times

zh.name: 迷梦香精
zh.effect: 所有自然回复技能的技力恢复+0.5/秒
zh.flavor: 据说女妖们制作的香氛只会送给心上之人，只需一滴，就能令人如痴如醉，而艺术家们的灵感与创意也随之而来。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计击败领袖【埃尔伯特】2次

en.name: Rusted Razor
en.effect: All enemies take +15% Physical damage
en.flavor: If you cut yourself with this, you know what will happen.

zh.name: 锈蚀刀片
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的物理伤害+15%
zh.flavor: 如果它割破了皮肤，你知道会发生什么。

en.name: Carriage Driver's Whip
en.effect: All enemies take +25% Physical damage
en.flavor: As the troupe's carriage driver, he has no name and no past. His life is meaningful only when he whips his burdenbeasts.

zh.name: 赶车夫的长鞭
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的物理伤害+25%
zh.flavor: 作为剧团的赶车人，他没有名字，没有过往。唯有挥鞭驱赶驮兽，他的生命才有意义。

en.name: 'Avenger'
en.effect: All enemies take +35% Physical damage
en.flavor: A gift from Theresis and set up by Theresa, this is the very first weapon that Ascalon received after her inaugural mission as part of the Military Council.

zh.name: “复仇者”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的物理伤害+35%
zh.flavor: 在阿斯卡纶第一次为军事委员会完成任务后，由特雷西斯亲手赠送，特蕾西娅为她安装的第一把武器。

en.name: Standard Anti-Riot Instrument
en.effect: All enemies take +20% Arts damage
en.flavor: Standard equipment of the Ursus Guard. Comes with an intermittent blinding Originium Arts effect. Unfortunately, not many Guards out there remember this when push comes to shove.

zh.name: 制式防暴用具
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的法术伤害+20%
zh.flavor: 乌萨斯军警的制式装备，自带施放间歇性致盲源石技艺的功能。可惜关键时刻想得起来这一功能的军警寥寥无几。

en.name: Emperor's Collection
en.effect: All enemies take +30% Arts damage
en.flavor: The Sami revere their wild lands more than anything, and this fragment of the vast wilderness sleeps in the personal collection of the Emperor of Ursus.

zh.name: 皇帝的收藏
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的法术伤害+30%
zh.flavor: 萨米人对他们的荒野尊崇无比，而现在这片荒野的碎片正静静躺在乌萨斯皇帝的私库中。

en.name: 'Brilliant Lament'
en.effect: All enemies take +40% Arts damage
en.flavor: His blood yet flows. He has never left this place.

zh.name: “璀璨悲泣”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的法术伤害+40%
zh.flavor: 他的血液仍在流淌，他从不曾真的自这里离开。

en.name: Oriron Round Shield
en.effect: All allied units have +15% DEF
en.flavor: Before the use of Oriron became widespread in today's industrial sector, the material was frequently used to forge military weapons like this one.

zh.name: 异铁小圆盾
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的防御力+15%
zh.flavor: 在异铁被广泛应用于现代工业领域前，这种材料时常被用来制造军用制式武器。

en.name: Military Mirror Armor
en.effect: All friendly units have +25% DEF
en.flavor: This mirror armor used to be able to withstand most attacks to the chest, but with the fall of Gaul, such archaic forms of armor have become museum pieces.

zh.name: 军团护心镜
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的防御力+25%
zh.flavor: 这种甲片曾经能够防护住针对心脏的致命伤害，但随着高卢没落，护心镜这种过时的护甲样式也退出了历史舞台。

en.name: Old Steam Armor
en.effect: All allied units gain +50% DEF
en.flavor: Even this old, outdated steam armor seems to carry with it the resplendence of when the Victorian monarchs cast their glory across half the world.
en.unlock: Select 'Ground Breaching Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 古旧的蒸汽甲胄
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的防御力+50%
zh.flavor: 哪怕是这种旧型号的蒸汽甲胄，也仿佛承载着维多利亚君主们照耀着半片大地的荣耀辉光。
zh.unlock: 选择【地面突破分队】完成游戏结局

en.name: Emperor's Favor
en.effect: All friendly melee units have +15% ATK
en.flavor: A very sharp letter opener. It was one of the favorite possessions of the last Ursus emperor, and as such it was very rarely used to actually open letters.

zh.name: 皇帝的恩宠
zh.effect: 所有我方近战单位的攻击力+15%
zh.flavor: 十分锋利的拆信刀。前任乌萨斯皇帝喜爱的日用品。大多数时候并不用来拆信。

en.name: Royal Rapier
en.effect: All allied melee units have +25% ATK
en.flavor: A highly decorative rapier for nobles. Used by Gaulish nobles first and foremost, though perhaps a little fragile for a military weapon.

zh.name: 贵族刺剑
zh.effect: 所有我方近战单位的攻击力+25%
zh.flavor: 装饰性强的贵族刺剑。高卢贵族首先使用，作为军事武器还是太脆了。

en.name: Vieux Vanguard's Blade
en.effect: All friendly melee units have +35% ATK
en.flavor: Prior to its downfall, Gaul first witnessed the sacrifices of its Vieux Vanguards.
en.unlock: Select 'Tactical Assault Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 老近卫军之锋
zh.effect: 所有我方近战单位的攻击力+35%
zh.flavor: 高卢将见证老近卫军的牺牲，随后才迎来自己的覆灭。
zh.unlock: 选择【突击战术分队】完成游戏结局

en.name: Necklace of the Presence
en.effect: All friendly ranged units have +15% ATK
en.flavor: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart, spoken words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.

zh.name: 显圣吊坠
zh.effect: 所有我方远程单位的攻击力+15%
zh.flavor: 信仰悬在你的心口上方十公分处，语言流入你的血液，子弹滑进你的弹仓。

en.name: Silver Forks
en.effect: All allied ranged units have +25% ATK
en.flavor: One for dealing with actors who botch their performances, one for dealing with incompetent playwrights, and one for anyone who needs it. The Chief will not tolerate any mistakes on the table.

zh.name: 银餐叉
zh.effect: 所有我方远程单位的攻击力+25%
zh.flavor: 一把用来处理失败的演员，一把用来收拾蹩脚的剧作者，还有一把留给有需要的人。厨师长不能容忍任何人在餐桌上出错。

en.name: Damaged Revolver Cylinder
en.effect: All friendly ranged units have +35% ATK
en.flavor: She never capitulated, even after enduring countless trials and tribulations. Her muzzle belched tongues of flame that burned like an angry sun, and the glow above her head was brighter than the daylight itself. Buried here is Outcast, our friend.
en.unlock: Select 'High Ground Breaching Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 损坏的左轮弹巢
zh.effect: 所有我方远程单位的攻击力+35%
zh.flavor: 她行过刀山火海也不曾有一刻向奸邪低头，她枪口火舌焦灼好似怒阳，她头顶光芒炽烈几胜白昼。此处安葬着Outcast，我们的朋友。
zh.unlock: 选择【高台突破分队】完成游戏结局

en.name: Doll House
en.effect: Starting DP +10
en.flavor: Every kid needs at least one set.

zh.name: 人偶之家
zh.effect: 初始部署费用+10
zh.flavor: 每个孩子都该有一套。

en.name: Miniature Stage Model
en.effect: Starting DP +20
en.flavor: The red paint has not yet dried. Careful. Don't get that paint on your hand.

zh.name: 微缩舞台模型
zh.effect: 初始部署费用+20
zh.flavor: 红色的颜料未干。小心，别染红了手。

en.name: Dreambind Castle Model
en.effect: Starting DP +30
en.flavor: You've seen this place, and you once wandered the castle, yet you now hold it in your hand. Is this real, or is it all a dream?

zh.name: 缠梦古堡模型
zh.effect: 初始部署费用+30
zh.flavor: 你见过这里，你曾在古堡中游荡，但你现在将其捧在掌心。这一切到底都是真的，还是只是一场梦？

en.name: Jet-Black Dance Shoes
en.effect: Can deploy Melee Operators on High Ground tiles
en.flavor: The Columbian dancer's steps are firm and strong, her taps reverberating loudly in the air as she strikes the ground.
en.unlock: Clear the third floor [Crimson Hollow Vein] having recruited 6 or more ranged Operators or 6 or more melee Operators, 3 times in total

zh.name: 漆黑的舞鞋
zh.effect: 可以在高台部署近战位干员
zh.flavor: 哥伦比亚的舞者踩踏大地，铿锵之声响亮悦耳。
zh.unlock: 通过第三层【血色空脉】时已招募大于等于6名远程位干员或大于等于6名近战位干员，累计3次

en.name: Pure White Dance Shoes
en.effect: Can deploy Ranged Operators on Low Ground tiles
en.flavor: The Ursus dancer's steps are swift and elegant, her body moving as she wills.
en.unlock: Clear the third floor [Crimson Hollow Vein] having recruited 6 or more ranged Operators or 6 or more melee Operators, 3 times in total

zh.name: 洁白的舞鞋
zh.effect: 可以在低地部署远程位干员
zh.flavor: 乌萨斯的舞者轻盈灵动，于天地间尽情舒展身姿。
zh.unlock: 通过第三层【血色空脉】时已招募大于等于6名远程位干员或大于等于6名近战位干员，累计3次

en.name: Chitinous Ripper
en.effect: When a battle begins, a random Operator will have +100% ATK and +100% HP for that battle
en.flavor: A more efficient way of growing an exoskeleton. It can tear prey apart, resist impact, and also be turned into a delicacy for its kin.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 8 times

zh.name: 几丁质刺刃
zh.effect: 战斗开始时，使随机一名干员在本局内攻击力+100%，生命+100%
zh.flavor: 一种更有效的外骨骼生长方案。能够撕裂猎物，抵御打击，也可以化作同胞的美食。
zh.unlock: 通关结局8次

en.name: Medicine Sticks
en.effect: All allied units gain 2 layers of Shield when deployed
en.flavor: Inspired by ancient Yanese soldiers who marched with something in their mouths to maintain silence, Mulberry created this edible hard plaster. Excellent for prolonged chewing and spirit lifting.

zh.name: 药枚
zh.effect: 所有我方单位在部署时获得2层护盾
zh.flavor: 古时炎国军队作战时，军士衔枚行军。桑葚从中得到灵感，制作了一款可食用的硬膏，非常锻炼咬肌，且醒神效果上佳。

en.name: Victory Horn
en.effect: Duration of single-instance status effects on enemies, such as Stun, Cold, or Freeze, is increased by 75%
en.flavor: Blow the horn, cry out, and scatter our foes with its roar!

zh.name: 凯旋号角
zh.effect: 敌人受到的一次性晕眩、寒冷、冻结等异常效果影响时间提高75%
zh.flavor: 吹响我们的号角，唤起我们的呼号，让敌人在震天咆哮中落荒而逃！

en.name: Therapy Tape
en.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 150%
en.flavor: He tried to stop you from listening. He said it was dangerous. He said you should not stay. Do you understand now? You are listening to his song.
en.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Supporter Operators in Squad

zh.name: 精神治疗录像带
zh.effect: 敌人受到的一次性晕眩、寒冷、冻结等异常效果影响时间提高150%
zh.flavor: 这是他曾经多次阻止你听的，他说这很危险，他说你不该逗留——现在你明白了吗？你在听他唱歌。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名辅助干员完成一场战斗

en.name: Gravity Defying Machine
en.effect: All enemies have -2 Weight
en.flavor: Nasti Lunorey's magnum opus lifted the Sarkaz from the land that had tormented them for thousands of years. Now, though they float in ethereal clouds, they remain firmly rooted in the sky.
en.unlock: Select 'Tactical Destruction Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 重力蔑视机关
zh.effect: 所有敌人重量-2
zh.flavor: 娜斯提·鲁诺瑞伊的杰作将萨卡兹托离了残害他们千万年的大地，此后，萨卡兹虽缥缈于云端，却将自己的根系，牢牢扎在了天空之上。
zh.unlock: 选择【破坏战术分队】完成游戏结局

en.name: Lakebed Aegis
en.effect: Objective Shield +1; all allied units gain +60% Max HP if you have any Objective Shield at the beginning of a battle
en.flavor: Three decades ago, a child dropped his toy wooden shield into the lake. Three decades later, he bores through the frozen lake, retrieves his shield, and embarks on a hero's journey.

zh.name: 湖中神盾
zh.effect: 护盾值+1；战斗开始时如果拥有护盾值，所有我方单位的最大生命+60%
zh.flavor: 三十年前，孩童的玩具木盾落入湖中。三十年后，他凿开冰封湖泊，取出盾牌，踏上英雄的旅途。

en.name: Spinach Pack
en.effect: All Operators have +60% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
en.flavor: Many Cautus out there believe that popping the contents of this can into their mouths will grant them immense strength. The marketing's effectiveness is a classic success story in the industry.

zh.name: 绿叶菜罐头
zh.effect: 所有干员技能触发后1秒内攻击力+60%
zh.flavor: 很多卡特斯相信吃下这盒罐头，他们就会变得力大无穷。出色的广告效果，业界经典成功案例。

en.name: Wrath of Siracusans
en.effect: All Operators have +100% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
en.flavor: The signature pasta dish of an 'authentic Siracusan restaurant' that once operated in the capital of Gaul. The dish's unique taste, and particularly its sauce—a blend of thick chocolate sauce and Originium Slug liver—earned the praise of many Gaulish nobles. Supposedly, though, this dish nearly caused a diplomatic crisis between Siracusa and Gaul.
en.unlock: Win the battle [Stranger Companions] while losing no more than 3 Life Points

zh.name: 叙拉古人的愤怒
zh.effect: 所有干员技能触发后1秒内攻击力+100%
zh.flavor: 曾经开设在高卢首都的一家“正宗叙拉古餐厅”的招牌面食，用浓郁的巧克力酱与源石虫肝制成的酱汁以其独特风味备受高卢贵族好评。但是据说差一点引起叙拉古与高卢的外交冲突。
zh.unlock: 在损失不超过3点目标生命的情况下胜利战斗【陌生旅伴】

en.name: Castle's Offspring
en.effect: All Operators have +400 DEF and +30 RES 80 seconds after deployment
en.flavor: With enough time, this box will become a whole new stage.
en.unlock: Complete an ending with at least 80 Operators deployed in battle during the whole adventure

zh.name: 古堡的子嗣
zh.effect: 所有干员在场上停留80秒后防御力+400，法术抗性+30
zh.flavor: 只要有足够时间，这个盒子便能成为另一座崭新的舞台。
zh.unlock: 累计在战斗中部署干员不小于80次的情况下完成游戏结局

en.name: Live Rose
en.effect: All allied units have +20% healing effectiveness
en.flavor: Is it you who nourishes her, or is it she who protects you?

zh.name: 活玫瑰
zh.effect: 所有我方单位受到的治疗和生命回复效果+20%
zh.flavor: 是你滋养她，还是她守护你？

en.name: White Flower Crown
en.effect: All allied units have +30% healing effectiveness
en.flavor: A floral veil used in Vampire rituals. Its once vibrant redness has been sucked empty, leaving only a pale white color.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 6 times

zh.name: 苍白花冠
zh.effect: 所有我方单位受到的治疗和生命回复效果+30%
zh.flavor: 血魔仪式使用的花冠头纱，曾经鲜红的生命被吮吸殆尽，现在只余苍白。
zh.unlock: 通关结局6次

en.name: Surging Feast
en.effect: All allied units have +40% healing effectiveness and take -30% Elemental Injury
en.flavor: We've known how to indulge since birth. Do not resist your desires. Submit to them instead.

zh.name: 涌动之餐
zh.effect: 所有我方单位受到的治疗和生命回复效果+40%，且受到的元素损伤-30%
zh.flavor: 我们生来便学会摄取。别违抗欲求，顺从它。

en.name: Worn-out Group Photo
en.effect: All enemy units have -5% Max HP and -10% DEF
en.flavor: Do you know someone in the photo?

zh.name: 残破合影
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命-5%，防御力-10%
zh.flavor: 里面有你认识的人吗？

en.name: Sea Terror Jerky
en.effect: All enemies have -10% HP and -20% DEF
en.flavor: When the will to survive outweighs fear, famished Iberians will consume this 'food', only to turn into Sea Terror in one of the days that follow.

zh.name: 恐鱼干
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命-10%，防御力-20%
zh.flavor: 当生存的欲望压过恐惧后，饥不择食的伊比利亚人会吞下这些“食物”，然后在某个平常的日子里成为恐鱼。

en.name: Rosmontis's Embrace
en.effect: All enemy units have -15% Max HP and -30% DEF
en.flavor: 'Who will be the judge?'

zh.name: 迷迭香之拥
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命-15%，防御力-30%
zh.flavor: “谁来审判？”

en.name: 'The Whisperer in Darknight'
en.effect: All enemy units have -15% HP
en.flavor: A black vinyl. DO. NOT. TOUCH. IT.

zh.name: “黑夜呢喃”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命-15%
zh.flavor: 一张黑色唱片。不。准。碰。它。

en.name: 'Profound Silence'
en.effect: All enemy units have -30% Max HP
en.flavor: A painting that depicts the greatest disaster in Iberian history. Its brushstrokes, colors, and images are all meaningless. 'The Ægir know. The Ægir know. The Ægir know.'

zh.name: 《大静谧》
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命-30%
zh.flavor: 描绘伊比利亚史上最大灾难的画作，笔触毫无意义，色彩毫无意义，意象毫无意义。“阿戈尔知道，阿戈尔知道，阿戈尔知道。”

en.name: First Aid Kit
en.effect: All allied units have +35% HP
en.flavor: '...Please use antibiotics and ethanol additives under the supervision of professionals...' —Rim Billiton Production Safety Manual

zh.name: 急救药箱
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的生命+35%
zh.flavor: “…抗生素与乙醇添加物，请在专业人士指导下使用…”——雷姆必拓安全生产指南

en.name: Unknown Instrument
en.effect: All allied units have +50% HP
en.flavor: Don't ask. It's for your own good.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 6 times

zh.name: 未知仪器
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的生命+50%
zh.flavor: 不要问。就当为了你自己好。
zh.unlock: 通关结局6次

en.name: Actor's Perfume
en.effect: All allied units recover 1% of Max HP per second
en.flavor: Troupe actors put this on before going onstage. Stable yet aromatic fragrances like this can help them ease pressure. That's how it seems on the surface, at least.

zh.name: 演出用香水
zh.effect: 所有我方单位每秒回复1%的最大生命值
zh.flavor: 剧团演员们上台前会喷一些在身上，这种稳定且芬芳的香气能为演员持续舒缓压力，至少，表面上，看上去是这样的。

en.name: Captain Morgan's Wine
en.effect: Starting SP +2; all Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills recover 1 SP every 3 seconds
en.flavor: A wine produced in the Iberian region. Despite having gained popularity in the heart of Victoria's bustling cities, it is now discontinued.

zh.name: 摩根队长佳酿
zh.effect: 初始技力+2，所有攻击和受击回复的技能每3秒回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 一种产自伊比利亚地区的酒，在维多利亚中部城市大受欢迎，现已停产。

en.name: Water of Life
en.effect: Starting SP +3; all Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills recover 1 SP every 2.5 seconds
en.flavor: The strongest Ursine liquors go straight to one's head, but it's said that the healthy Ursine adult can down several bottles.

zh.name: 生命之水
zh.effect: 初始技力+3，所有攻击和受击回复的技能每2.5秒回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 度数奇高的乌萨斯烈酒，上头，据说一个健康的乌萨斯人能干掉好几瓶。

en.name: Royal Liqueur
en.effect: Starting SP +5; all Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills recover 1 SP every 1.5 seconds
en.flavor: The fine wines of the extinct country, Gaul, have now become expensive, prime treasures for collectors. The place of production is now a part of Leithanien, but the technique has been lost.
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader [De León] a total of 2 times

zh.name: 皇家利口酒
zh.effect: 初始技力+5，所有攻击和受击回复的技能每1.5秒回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 已灭亡国家“高卢”的好酒，现在成为了收藏家手中的珍惜奇货，价格不菲。产地现处莱塔尼亚境内，工艺则已经失传。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计击败领袖【德莱昂】2次

en.name: Bank of Gaul Check
en.effect: All Operators start with +12 SP
en.flavor: An extravagant checkbook plated in gold and silver. Can no longer be cashed.

zh.name: 高卢银行支票
zh.effect: 所有干员的初始技力+12
zh.flavor: 镶金嵌银、奢华无比的支票本，现在已经无从兑现。

en.name: 'Second Economic Reform Act'
en.effect: All Operators start with +18 SP
en.flavor: With this bill as the starting point, Gaul formally began its path to become a hegemonic empire.
en.unlock: Win the battle [Partners' Meeting] while losing no more than 3 Life Points

zh.name: 《第二经济改革法》
zh.effect: 所有干员的初始技力+18
zh.flavor: 以此法案为起点，高卢正式迈向了霸权帝国的道路。
zh.unlock: 在损失不超过3点目标生命的情况下胜利战斗【合伙人会议】

en.name: Ribbon of Honor
en.effect: All allied units have +100% ATK when blocking only 1 enemy
en.flavor: Numerous actors have played this character, yet none of them were able to save the character's dearest friend.

zh.name: 荣耀绶带
zh.effect: 所有我方单位仅阻挡1名敌人时，攻击力+100%
zh.flavor: 曾有无数位演员出演这个角色，但永远救不了这个角色心目中的挚友。

en.name: Living Woodplate
en.effect: All allied melee units gain a Barrier equal to 50% of their Max HP on deployment
en.flavor: Shamans know the formidable will to survive that trees possess, so when a warrior has a similar will, they invite the trees to be their armor.
en.unlock: Select 'Tactical Fortification Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 活木甲
zh.effect: 所有我方近战单位部署时获得相当于最大生命50%的屏障
zh.flavor: 萨满们知晓树木对于生存的执着，所以当战士也拥有这种意志时，他们便会邀请树木成为战士的护甲。
zh.unlock: 选择【堡垒战术分队】完成游戏结局

en.name: Emergency Stimulant
en.effect: The lower an Operator's HP, the faster their attack speed, reaching the maximum bonus (+100 ASPD) at 30% HP
en.flavor: An injection commonly used in Rim Billiton's local mines. Its strong active ingredient can stimulate the workers' senses and ensure their work efficiency in extreme environments. When life and their project both present their deadlines, sometimes the choice is simpler than one might think.

zh.name: 紧急活性剂
zh.effect: 干员生命值越低，攻击速度越快，30%生命值时达到最大可提升攻击速度（+100）
zh.flavor: 雷姆必拓当地矿场常用的一种针剂，强活性成分可以刺激工人的感官，保证其在极端环境下的工作效率。生命和工程都有期限，对他们而言，这仅仅是个选择题。

en.name: 'Ah Meng'
en.effect: All enemies take +100% Elemental Damage
en.flavor: During the calamity of the bestial Sui's awakening a century ago, the Sui Regulators used specially trained beckbeasts to track and eliminate geists. This ceramic sculpture commemorates the beckbeasts' sacrifice.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 5 times

zh.name: “阿猛”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的元素伤害+100%
zh.flavor: 百年前岁兽苏醒的灾祸中，司岁台曾借助经特殊训练的循兽，对伥怪进行全方位的搜索及消灭。此陶制品为纪念当时牺牲的循兽而制。
zh.unlock: 通关结局5次

en.name: Convalescence Access Card
en.effect: Operators gain +40 ASPD for 10 seconds after deployment
en.flavor: A special service from the Convalescent Garden! Each Operator is entitled to one physiotherapy session from the Convalescent Garden before each of their field operations. Non-transferrable.

zh.name: 疗养体验卡
zh.effect: 所有干员部署后10秒内攻击速度+40
zh.flavor: 疗养庭院特别服务！每位干员在执行外勤任务前，均可前往疗养庭院接受神经调理一次。名额不可转让。

en.name: Convalescence Premium Card
en.effect: Operators gain +70 ASPD for 10 seconds after deployment
en.flavor: A special collaboration between Convalescent Garden and the Medical Department! Each Operator receives a comprehensive physical and psychological assessment, plus a physiotherapy session. Afterwards, they can enjoy Podenco's homemade flower cakes.

zh.name: 疗养特供卡
zh.effect: 所有干员部署后10秒内攻击速度+70
zh.flavor: 疗养庭院联合医疗部特供！每位干员在执行外勤任务前，均可前往疗养庭院接受全面的身心状态评估，以及神经调理一次，结束后还可品尝波登可自制的花饼。

en.name: String Puppet
en.effect: Enemies receive 1000 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound
en.flavor: The more you struggle and try to break free, the tighter the strings get. Do you really think you are still thinking rationally?

zh.name: 悬丝傀儡
zh.effect: 敌人被晕眩、冻结、束缚时，每秒受到1000点法术伤害
zh.flavor: 越是用力想要挣脱，丝线就缠得越紧。你真的认为自己仍在思考？

en.name: 'Children's Puppet'
en.effect: Enemies receive 2000 Arts Damage per second while Stunned, Frozen, or Bound
en.flavor: A simple puppet made by Iberian children using trinkets found on the seacoast. Supposedly just holding it tight will give you much richer dreams.

zh.name: “童趣玩偶”
zh.effect: 敌人被晕眩、冻结、束缚时，每秒受到2000点法术伤害
zh.flavor: 伊比利亚的孩童们将海岸边的奇物做成了简陋玩偶，听说只要抱着它，梦乡就会变得充实起来。

en.name: 'Unleashings'
en.effect: All Operators recover 1 SP every time they take damage or Elemental Injury
en.flavor: After several attempts by Touch, nature briefly opens up to you.

zh.name: “绽放”
zh.effect: 所有干员每次受到伤害时回复1点技力，每次受到元素损伤时回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 在Touch的尝试下，自然暂时向你敞开心扉。

en.name: Celestial Dust
en.effect: Ranged Operators Levitate all enemies within attack range for 5 seconds when a skill is manually activated
en.flavor: She gently blows away the countless records of sunrises, moonsets, and the changing of the stars. Her life is blown away that easily.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 7 times

zh.name: 天穹尘埃
zh.effect: 远程干员在手动开启技能时，使攻击范围内的所有敌人浮空5秒
zh.flavor: 她轻轻吹动无数次日升月落、星辰更替的记录。她的生命轻易就被吹走。
zh.unlock: 通关结局7次

en.name: Ancient Fresco
en.effect: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 1000 Arts damage and are Silenced for 10 seconds
en.flavor: Walk out of the cave, and raise your head. This has never been right, even since antiquity.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 7 times

zh.name: 古老壁画
zh.effect: 敌人进入和解除浮空、失重状态时，受到1000点法术伤害，并在10秒内失去特殊能力
zh.flavor: 走出洞窟，抬头看看吧，自古以来，也不尽然。
zh.unlock: 通关结局7次

en.name: Galleria Stellaria's Splendor
en.effect: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 2000 Arts damage and take 30% more damage for 10 seconds
en.flavor: At that moment, the light of truth shone onto the earth.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 7 times

zh.name: 万星园之辉
zh.effect: 敌人进入和解除浮空、失重状态时，受到2000点法术伤害，并在10秒内受到的伤害+30%
zh.flavor: 在那一瞬，真实之光普照大地。
zh.unlock: 通关结局7次

en.name: Scout's Scope
en.effect: Enemies take increased damage from allied units as range increases (max 100%)
en.flavor: Lock on, aim, fire, and destroy the enemy's will to resist, all in the name of a better future that Scout will never see. Maybe you can do it for him.
en.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Sniper Operators in Squad

zh.name: Scout的狙击镜
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到我方单位伤害时，距离伤害来源越远受到的伤害越高（最高100%）
zh.flavor: 锁定目标、维持精度、扣下扳机、摧毁敌人抵抗的意志，这一切都是为了那个更远大的未来。Scout已经没有机会看到了，或许你可以帮忙见证。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名狙击干员完成一场战斗

en.name: Blaze's Chainsaw
en.effect: Enemies take increased damage from allied units as distance is reduced (max 100%)
en.flavor: She drags herself into hell with her enemies, appraising each other's determination with heat. She has never failed.
en.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Guard Operators

zh.name: Blaze的电锯
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到我方单位伤害时，距离伤害来源越近受到的伤害越高（最高100%）
zh.flavor: 她将自己与敌人一同拖入地狱，用炽热来鉴定彼此的决心。她从未失败。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名近卫干员完成一场战斗

en.name: Black Tulip
en.effect: Allied Operators gradually gain ATK when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +60% after 60s; bonus is reset when skill ends
en.flavor: Silence crushed the Iberians, so she knows she must speak up. If her words aren't sharp enough, her sword will speak for her.

zh.name: 黑色郁金香
zh.effect: 所有我方干员技能未开启时60秒内攻击力逐渐提升至最高+60%，每次技能结束时失去该加成
zh.flavor: 沉默压垮了伊比利亚人，所以她要发声，如果言语不够锐利，那就以剑代言。

en.name: 'Glorious Kazimierz'
en.effect: Operators gain +70 ASPD for 15 seconds after dodging
en.flavor: A Kazimierzian best-seller that adapts the deeds of the arena's brightest-shining knights into a novel. Nearl, who was exiled but returned to reclaim her laurels, occupies a considerable portion of its pages.
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, win a total of 40 battles

zh.name: 《光耀卡西米尔》
zh.effect: 干员触发闪避后15秒内攻击速度+70
zh.flavor: 卡西米尔畅销书，以小说笔调讲述了自有骑士竞技以来那些闪耀竞技场的骑士事迹。惨遭放逐但重夺桂冠的临光占据了相当大的篇幅。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计胜利40场战斗

en.name: 'The Return'
en.effect: Operators gain +130% ATK for 15 seconds after dodging
en.flavor: This Kazimierzian best-seller is said to be a collective creation by fans. 'Nearl' has already become an amalgamation of many ideals and fantasies. 'For her, exile was not an escape. She came back, and stood alone against the era's torrents.'
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, win a total of 60 battles

zh.name: 《归来》
zh.effect: 干员触发闪避后15秒内攻击力+130%
zh.flavor: 卡西米尔畅销书，据说是粉丝的集体创作，“临光”已然成为糅杂了诸多幻想的形象复合体。“放逐，并非逃避。她归来，独自抵挡时代的洪流。”
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计胜利60场战斗

en.name: Designer's Ruler
en.effect: All allied units have +15% Physical Dodge
en.flavor: Carefully measured with data and experience, those who wear this armor are known to be several magnitudes luckier.

zh.name: 设计师量尺
zh.effect: 所有我方单位获得15%物理闪避
zh.flavor: 在数据、经验以及精确测量下，身着铠甲的人多了几分幸运。

en.name: 'Arts Killer'
en.effect: All allied units have +15% Arts Dodge
en.flavor: Considering how Originium Arts and music go hand in hand in Leithanien, it's quite amazing someone came up with the bright idea of combating Arts with noise like this.

zh.name: “法术杀手”
zh.effect: 所有我方单位获得15%法术闪避
zh.flavor: 由于莱塔尼亚人的源石技艺与音乐息息相关，有人竟想出了用噪音对抗法术的蠢主意。

en.name: Dancer's Bracelets
en.effect: All allied units have +10% Physical and Arts Dodge
en.flavor: The audience breaks into applause as the well-trained dancers waltz around the traps on stage. None of them are aware of the brushes with death the performers have just been through.

zh.name: 舞者手链
zh.effect: 所有我方单位获得10%物理与法术闪避
zh.flavor: 训练有素的舞者在舞台上翩翩起舞躲过陷阱，观众们鼓掌喝彩，全然不知有人刚刚与死亡擦肩而过。

en.name: Rock Horn
en.effect: An Operator gains ATK +20% for every Operator in the adjacent 4 tiles
en.flavor: If you want to gather up manpower in Sami, blowing a trumpet is definitely the best way to do it.

zh.name: 岩角号
zh.effect: 所有干员周围4格每有一名干员，攻击力+20%
zh.flavor: 想要在萨米召集人手，吹号绝对是最为有效的措施。

en.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips
en.effect: [Summons] have -5 DP Cost, +30% Max HP, and +30% ATK, and no longer use Deployment slots
en.flavor: 'Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.'

zh.name: 散轶诗简
zh.effect: 【召唤物】的部署费用-5、生命值+30%、攻击力+30%，并且不再消耗部署位
zh.flavor: “酣然失千山，万物得其灵。”

en.name: Woodblock Prints
en.effect: After Operators use an ammo-type skill, gain +2% ATK every time they deal damage (Stacks to 30 times)
en.flavor: Popular poems engraved on jujube wood. When aloof scholars spot poems they deem inferior circulating amongst the masses, they often scoff and sneer: 'Hmph. What a tragedy, a crime, to waste fine wood like that.'
en.unlock: Reach an ending 9 times

zh.name: 传芳雕版
zh.effect: 干员开启弹药类技能后，每次造成伤害时，攻击力+2%（最多叠加30层）
zh.flavor: 流行诗集的枣木雕版。见到自己眼中欠佳的俗诗雕版广为流传时，清高文人往往嗤之以鼻：“哼，可悲枣树，罪不至此。”
zh.unlock: 通关结局9次

en.name: Three Feet To All
en.effect: After Operators use an ammo-type skill, +100 ASPD for 15 second
en.flavor: An ancient Yanese movable type printing press. A noble uses words as weapons, while villains... there was once a time when the printing house discovered the word block for 'not' was stolen right before they went to print a work, and the rebuttal text's meaning changed entirely, leaving one unsure whether to cry or not.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 9 times

zh.name: 三尺万象
zh.effect: 干员开启弹药类技能时，攻击速度+100，持续15秒
zh.flavor: 古时炎国印书坊所用活字印刷机。君子以字为利器，而小人......曾有印书坊下印前，发现“非”字被偷，驳斥之文意思骤变，令人啼笑皆非。
zh.unlock: 通关结局9次

en.name: 'Yanese Dictionary'
en.effect: When Operators use an ammo-type skill and consume 70% of ammo for the first time, replenishes 30% of max ammo count
en.flavor: Yan's first ever common dictionary, compiled by a civilian writer after over a decade of work. The editor often sighed over how thin the volumes were despite the amount of text, and dedicated a tomb to rare characters that could not be included or recorded.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 9 times

zh.name: 《炎国字汇》
zh.effect: 弹药类技能每次开启后，首次剩余30%的弹药时，补充最大弹药数量30%的弹药
zh.flavor: 炎国的第一本通用字典，由民间作者历经十年完成。编者常叹书薄而字多，为无法收录、注定失传的生僻字立有一方字冢。
zh.unlock: 通关结局9次

en.name: 'Collection of Elegance'
en.effect: When Operators use an ammo-type skill and consume 70% of ammo for the first time, replenishes 50% of max ammo count
en.flavor: Yan's first poetry collection containing the most popular poems of the year it was published. Its immense popularity sparked a surge within the masses to copy the poems or write new ones, leading to a shortage of paper and ink.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 9 times

zh.name: 《雅集》
zh.effect: 弹药类技能每次开启后，首次剩余30%的弹药时，补充最大弹药数量50%的弹药
zh.flavor: 炎国的第一部诗集，收录了当年传唱最广的诗篇。因其广受欢迎，促使民间抄诗与写诗的热情剧增，一度导致当年的纸墨供不应求。
zh.unlock: 通关结局9次

en.name: 'Blademace'
en.effect: All Operators have +3 DP Cost, but gain +50% ATK, DEF, and Max HP
en.flavor: A sword lodged in a stone. Was someone bored enough to do this?

zh.name: “剑锤”
zh.effect: 所有干员的部署费用+3，但攻击力、防御力和生命+50%
zh.flavor: 插在巨大石头上的剑，到底是谁这么无聊啊。

en.name: Crown of the Red Sun
en.effect: Ranged-tile Operators' first hit on each enemy deals 300% damage
en.flavor: It gave the crown It loved to Its Liberi child. The Liberi accepted the crown, and accepted the daylight too. And so the Liberi soared above the mountaintops, and from then on the land knew no night.

zh.name: 红日冠冕
zh.effect: 高台干员对每个敌人首次造成的伤害提升至300%
zh.flavor: 祂将自己所喜爱的冠冕赠与祂的黎博利孩子。黎博利接受了冠冕，也接受了白昼。于是黎博利翱翔于山巅之上，从此大地没有了黑夜。

en.name: Shawl of the Dark Night
en.effect: Ground Operators' first hit on each enemy deals 300% damage
en.flavor: It gave the shawl It loved to Its Phidia child. The Phidia accepted the shawl, but received no daylight. And so the Phidia stole the Liberi's crown, and from then on the land had night once more.

zh.name: 黑夜披肩
zh.effect: 地面干员对每个敌人首次造成的伤害提升至300%
zh.flavor: 祂将自己所喜爱的披肩赠与祂的斐迪亚孩子。斐迪亚接受了披肩，没有得到白昼。于是斐迪亚偷走了黎博利的冠冕，从此大地又有了黑夜。

en.name: False Wings
en.effect: When an allied Operator defeats an enemy, they gain Camouflage for 3 seconds
en.flavor: "That tree has one last leaf left. We can make it through this winter..."
en.unlock: Reach an ending 1 time

zh.name: 伪翅
zh.effect: 我方干员击倒敌人时，获得3秒迷彩
zh.flavor: “那棵树还剩最后一片叶子，我们能挺过这个冬天......”
zh.unlock: 通关结局1次

en.name: "Thirst to Bite"
en.effect: When an allied Operator defeats an enemy, they gain +100 ASPD for 2 seconds
en.flavor: Blood only drives them into a greater frenzy. Where are they? Everywhere.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 1 time

zh.name: “撕咬的渴望”
zh.effect: 我方干员击倒敌人时，攻击速度+100，持续2秒
zh.flavor: 鲜血只会让它们更加亢奋。它们在哪里？无处不在。
zh.unlock: 通关结局1次

en.name: Musk Horn
en.effect: When an allied Operator defeats an enemy, they gain 2 SP
en.flavor: A broken-off horn giving off an exciting scent, seemingly shed when two males fought in the Treesea. Fighting is forever addictive.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 1 time

zh.name: 异香角
zh.effect: 我方干员击倒敌人时，获得2点技力
zh.flavor: 一截断角，散发着令人兴奋的味道，似乎是树海中两头雄性生物打架时掉下的，争斗永远使人成瘾。
zh.unlock: 通关结局1次

en.name: Bloodthirsty Pincer Beast
en.effect: When an allied Operator defeats an enemy, they restore 10% of their Max HP
en.flavor: Watching pincer beasts fight is fun, as long as it isn't your fingers they're pinching.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 1 time

zh.name: 渴血钳兽
zh.effect: 我方干员击倒敌人时，回复10%最大生命
zh.flavor: 观赏钳兽争斗很有趣，前提是它们钳住的不是你的手指。
zh.unlock: 通关结局1次

en.name: "Shelter"
en.effect: Ranged-tile Operators immediately gain a Barrier equal to 100% of their Max HP when deployed
en.flavor: Their sweat fell like the Treesea's rain, but luckily they had the leaves that kept off the rain to keep off the blazing sun as well.

zh.name: “庇护”
zh.effect: 高台干员部署时立刻获得最大生命100%的屏障
zh.flavor: 他们的汗水如树海的雨水般落下，但好在他们有遮挡雨水的叶子来遮挡烈日。

en.name: Planter's Insurance Policy
en.effect: If an allied Operator takes no damage for 5 seconds, they gain a Barrier equal to 20% of their Max HP
en.flavor: A densely printed insurance policy whose terms only apply if the insured has no accidents. Luckily, they can't read it anyway.

zh.name: 种植者保单
zh.effect: 若我方干员在5秒内未受到伤害，则获得最大生命20%的屏障
zh.flavor: 一份印得密密麻麻的保单，但条款只在被保人没出意外时有效——好在他们也看不懂上面的内容。

en.name: Tactical Vest
en.effect: While an allied Operator has a Barrier, they deal 140% damage
en.flavor: "I think it could use a few more pockets. I need somewhere to tuck my mom's photo."
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader [Hanko] a total of 2 times

zh.name: 战术背心
zh.effect: 我方干员拥有屏障时，造成的伤害提升至140%
zh.flavor: “我觉得口袋最好再多一些，得找个地方把我老妈的照片塞进去。”
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计击败领袖【汉科】2次

en.name: Blessing of the Newborn
en.effect: The first Operator deployed gains a Barrier equal to 300% of their Max HP, and while it holds a Barrier, its attacks deal additional Arts Damage equal to 50% of its ATK
en.flavor: A traditional gift for newborns, first brought home from Bolivar by Leithanien officers and later localized. No one refuses a blessing for a new life.

zh.name: 赐福新生
zh.effect: 首个干员部署时获得最大生命300%的屏障，且拥有屏障时攻击额外造成攻击力50%的法术伤害
zh.flavor: 赠予新生儿的特色礼物，最初由莱塔尼亚军官从玻利瓦尔归乡时带回，后经历了本土化，没有人会拒绝对新生命的祝福。

en.name: Bound by Another
en.effect: All Operators have -50% DP Cost, but lose 70% of their current HP after deployment (applies only once until they leave the field)
en.flavor: You dug it out of the soil, yet it is taking revenge for this land.

zh.name: 他缚
zh.effect: 所有干员部署费用-50%，部署后损失70%的当前生命（退场前仅生效一次）
zh.flavor: 你从泥土中挖出了它，它却在为这片土地复仇。

en.name: Bloodstained Dictionary
en.effect: When an Operator's HP falls below 10%, they immediately gain a Barrier equal to 100% of their Max HP (once only)
en.flavor: It once blocked a fatal blow for a true Bolivarian guerrilla who was learning to write. Sadly, its owner didn't hold out much longer, nor learn many more words.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 2 times

zh.name: 染血辞典
zh.effect: 所有干员生命值低于10%时，仅一次立刻获得最大生命100%的屏障
zh.flavor: 它曾为一名正在学习书写的真正玻利瓦尔游击队员挡下致命一击，遗憾的是它的拥有者没能撑太久，也没能认识更多词。
zh.unlock: 通关结局2次

en.name: Liquid Fertilizer
en.effect: When allied Operators attack, they lose 50 HP (always keeping at least 1) and gain a 100-point Barrier (Barrier from this effect is capped at 100% of Max HP)
en.flavor: Wherever it goes, there is a bumper harvest. But the cost? At any rate, it isn't the harvesters who pay it.

zh.name: 液体化肥
zh.effect: 我方干员攻击时流失50点生命（至少保留1点），获得100屏障（此效果获得的屏障最大为100%生命上限）
zh.flavor: 它所到之处皆是丰收，但代价呢？总之不是收获者来付出。

en.name: Hot Spicy Cocoa
en.effect: The lower an Operator's HP, the higher their ATK, reaching the maximum bonus (+150% ATK) at 30% HP
en.flavor: A drink combining chili and cocoa. From the ingredients alone you can't imagine how it tastes, but it's very popular with tourists in Dossoles.

zh.name: 热辣可可
zh.effect: 干员生命值越低，攻击力越高，30%生命值时达到最大可提升攻击力（+150%）
zh.flavor: 辣椒和可可结合的饮品，单听原料想象不出结合出来的口感，但在多索雷斯的游客当中很受欢迎。

en.name: Painkillers
en.effect: The lower an Operator's HP, the faster their SP recovery, reaching the maximum rate (+2/s) at 30% HP
en.flavor: These painkillers are well loved in Columbia, but gathering their raw materials is extremely dangerous, and the Bolivarians who pick them rarely get the chance to use them.

zh.name: 止痛片
zh.effect: 干员生命值越低，技力恢复速度越快，30%生命值时达到最大恢复速度（+2/s）
zh.flavor: 这种止痛片广受哥伦比亚人好评，获取其原材料却极其凶险，而负责采摘的玻利瓦尔人通常没有机会使用它。

en.name: Skyrocket Originium Slug
en.effect: When an Operator takes off, deal Physical Damage equal to 400% of their ATK to all enemies within attack range
en.flavor: Ask what Yan children love most on New Year's Eve, and the answer has to be Originium Slug firecrackers that shoot into the sky the moment they're lit.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 4 times

zh.name: 窜天源石虫
zh.effect: 干员起飞时，对攻击范围内所有敌人造成相当于自身攻击力400%的物理伤害
zh.flavor: 要问什么东西是大炎小孩在除夕夜最喜欢的——非点燃后火速升空的源石虫爆竹莫属。
zh.unlock: 通关结局4次

en.name: Ground Popper
en.effect: When an Operator lands, deal Physical Damage equal to 200% of their ATK and a 2-second Stun to all enemies within attack range
en.flavor: They often turn out to be duds, but the instant one is smashed on the ground, passing Yan folk still step briskly aside.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 4 times

zh.name: 贴地炸
zh.effect: 干员降落时，对攻击范围内所有敌人造成相当于自身攻击力200%的物理伤害和2秒晕眩
zh.flavor: 虽然经常会出现哑炮的情况，但被摔在地上的一瞬间，路过的大炎人还是会快步闪开。
zh.unlock: 通关结局4次

en.name: Soaring Wings
en.effect: For each allied unit that has taken off, all units that have taken off gain +25% ATK
en.flavor: From this intact pair of wings you can still glimpse how their owner once ruled the skies. But the contest is decided, and the loser must pay the price.

zh.name: 翱翼
zh.effect: 我方每有1个起飞的单位，所有起飞的单位攻击力+25%
zh.flavor: 从这对完整的羽翼中，仍能窥见它们的所有者曾翱翔于空中称霸的模样，但胜负已定，落败者需付出代价。

en.name: Serpent's Molt
en.effect: For each allied unit that has not taken off, all units gain +10% DEF
en.flavor: From this intact snakeskin you can still glimpse how its owner once coiled over the ground as its ruler. But the contest is decided, and the loser must pay the price.

zh.name: 虬蜕
zh.effect: 我方每有1个未起飞的单位，所有单位的防御力+10%
zh.flavor: 从这张完整的蛇蜕中，仍能窥见它的所有者曾盘踞于地面称霸的模样，但胜负已定，落败者需付出代价。

en.name: Tianshi's Silk Pouch
en.effect: When a Yan Operator is deployed for the first time, summon a [Yan Guardian] at their position
en.flavor: When in doubt, pull out the silk pouch the Tianshi gave you. It may not offer advice, but at least it can offer armed support.
en.unlock: Reach an ending 5 times

zh.name: 天师锦囊
zh.effect: 首次部署炎国干员时，在其位置召唤一只【炎佑】
zh.flavor: 遇事不决，可掏出天师赠与的锦囊。锦囊不一定会提供建议，但至少可提供武力支援。
zh.unlock: 通关结局5次

en.name: Fire in Ice
en.effect: Enemies take +75% Elemental Injury and Elemental Damage
en.flavor: The fire keeps burning, yet the ice never melts. It looks hot but feels cold to the touch, just like everything you see in the Blackstream Treesea.

zh.name: 冰中火
zh.effect: 敌人受到的元素损伤和元素伤害+75%
zh.flavor: 火一直在燃烧，冰却一直未融。看起来很热，摸起来却是冷的，正如你在黑流树海中所见的一切。

en.name: River Valley Rite
en.effect: Enhances the Burst effects of allied Necrosis, Burning, Nervous Impairment, and Corrosion
en.flavor: The dust closed her eyes, and the stream wiped away her tears.

zh.name: 河谷祭祈
zh.effect: 我方凋亡、灼燃、神经和侵蚀损伤的爆发效果增强
zh.flavor: 尘土阖上她的眼睛，溪流为她拭去泪水。

en.name: Hound Disease Remedy
en.effect: After an allied Frenzy elemental Burst, no longer take continuous damage, and gain an additional +50 ASPD for its duration
en.flavor: A remedy that briefly suppresses the symptoms of hound disease. Only briefly: medical staff and researchers still cannot cure it.

zh.name: 猎犬病特效药
zh.effect: 我方狂躁元素爆发后不再受到持续伤害，且期间攻击速度额外+50
zh.flavor: 可以短暂抑制猎犬病症状的特效药，但仅仅是短暂抑制，医疗及研究人员至今无法根除此病。

en.name: Special Ops Riot Shield
en.effect: Blocked enemies deal -30% damage
en.flavor: Blacksteel Worldwide's equipment and applied technology department spares no effort in cutting weight, hoping to lighten the burden in mercenaries' hands in combat, and maybe the burden on their minds too... perhaps.
en.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators in Squad

zh.name: 特种作战防暴盾
zh.effect: 被阻挡的敌人造成的伤害-30%
zh.flavor: 黑钢国际的装备与应用技术部门不遗余力地追求轻量化，希望佣兵作战时手上的负担能小一点，心理上的负担也能小一点......也许吧。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名重装干员完成一场战斗

en.name: Hound Coffee
en.effect: Allied units gain +30% Max HP and ATK; enemies have a 3% chance to spawn with +100% Max HP
en.flavor: Wild coffee beans from where the hounds roam always taste better. Nobody knows why, but that hasn't stopped them fetching ever-higher prices in Columbia. Whether they were really picked in hound territory hardly matters anymore.

zh.name: 猎犬咖啡
zh.effect: 我方单位的生命和攻击力+30%，敌人出现时有3%概率生命+100%
zh.flavor: 猎犬出没之地的野生咖啡豆总是更加美味，虽然不知道原因，但并不妨碍这些咖啡豆在哥伦比亚被炒出一波又一波高价，至于是否真的是从猎犬的领地摘取的，也并不重要了。

en.name: Arena VIP Ticket
en.effect: Elite enemies gain +10% Max HP; Originium Ingots and Command EXP gained from battles +40%
en.flavor: For just another hundred thousand marks, you can upgrade from Super-Super VIP to Super-Super-Super VIP!

zh.name: 竞技场贵宾券
zh.effect: 精英敌人的生命+10%，战斗获得的源石锭和指挥经验+40%
zh.flavor: 只要再加十万马克，您就可以从超超级贵宾升级为超超超级贵宾！

en.name: Golden Plains
en.effect: Allied Operators gain 2 SP when their skill ends
en.flavor: Endless golden wheat fields, a gentle breeze, people's laughter. Why wait long for your next craft brew?

zh.name: 黄金平原
zh.effect: 我方干员技能结束时获得2点技力
zh.flavor: 一望无际的金色麦田、微风、人们的欢声笑语，你的下一瓶精酿何必等待太久？

en.name: The First Rule
en.effect: Allied Operators gain 4 SP when their skill ends
