en.flavor: Red wine from Siracusa has only one name: winner takes all, forever the first rule here.

zh.name: 第一法则
zh.effect: 我方干员技能结束时获得4点技力
zh.flavor: 叙拉古出品的红酒只有一种名字——赢家通吃，永远是这里的第一法则。

en.name: Special Mission Footage
en.effect: Allied units gain +40% Max HP, ATK, and DEF; Command EXP +20%
en.flavor: Whoever recorded this footage survived. To the next special investigator who watches it: good luck.

zh.name: 特勤任务影像
zh.effect: 我方单位的生命、攻击力、防御力+40%，指挥经验+20%
zh.flavor: 录制影像的人活下来了，下一位观看影像的特勤调查员，祝你好运。

en.name: Pathfinder Vanguard
en.effect: Gain 1 stack after completing a "Pursuit" operation, reducing the next Area's starting Action Points by 1; each stack gives "Hound Proto" +20% Max HP and ATK
en.flavor: You were lucky to escape death in the "Pursuit". You are hereby awarded the "Pathfinder Vanguard" medal in recognition, and we look forward to an even more spectacular performance next time.

zh.name: 探测先锋
zh.effect: 完成“追猎”作战后叠加1层并使下个区域初始行动力-1，每层使“猎犬proto”的生命和攻击力+20%
zh.flavor: 你幸运地在“追猎”中死里逃生，现颁发“探测先锋”奖章，以兹鼓励，期待下一次更精彩的表现。

en.name: Blunt Claws - Undaunted
en.effect: Vanguard Operators have +50% ATK and DEF
en.flavor: Strike while morale is high, and seize the initiative over the foe.

zh.name: 钝爪-屡战
zh.effect: 所有【先锋】干员的攻击力+50%，防御力+50%
zh.flavor: 一鼓作气，克敌机先。

en.name: Blunt Claws - Mastery
en.effect: For 60 seconds after the start of battle, all Vanguards gain +100% ATK and DEF
en.flavor: 'When the darkly-clad enemies rushed towards me, there were only four words on my mind — they are done for.'

zh.name: 钝爪-百战
zh.effect: 战斗开始60秒内，所有【先锋】攻击力+100%，防御力+100%
zh.flavor: “当黑漆漆的敌人向我涌来时，我脑海里只想到四个字——它们完了。”

en.name: Bend Spears - Acuity
en.effect: Guard Operators have +25% ATK
en.flavor: 'This is the 7th blade you've broken this month.' 'But I cut down eight enemies this month.'

zh.name: 折戟-锋刃
zh.effect: 所有【近卫】干员的攻击力+25%
zh.flavor: “这是你这个月砍坏的第七把刀了。”“但是我这个月砍了八个敌人。”

en.name: Bend Spears - Bloodbath
en.effect: Guard Operators restore 2 SP after each attack
en.flavor: Soldiers who get bolder as time passes are rare. Most need some form of psychological counseling to alleviate the trauma of war.

zh.name: 折戟-浴血
zh.effect: 所有【近卫】干员在攻击后获得2点技力
zh.flavor: 愈战愈勇的战士十分少见，我们常需要安排一些心理辅导来缓和战后的情绪。

en.name: Iron Guard - Invasion
en.effect: Defender Operators have +60% ATK
en.flavor: Defensive actions for the sake of teammates or strategic purposes often make people forget about their original aggressiveness.

zh.name: 铁卫-侵掠
zh.effect: 所有【重装】干员的攻击力+60%
zh.flavor: 对队友和战略目的的保护行动往往会让人忽视他们原本的侵略性。

en.name: Iron Guard - Consolidation
en.effect: Defender Operators gain +40% HP, +40% DEF, and +20 RES
en.flavor: No matter how heavy fate's blow is, take it.

zh.name: 铁卫-整固
zh.effect: 所有【重装】干员生命值+40%，防御力+40%，法术抗性+20
zh.flavor: 无论命运的打击多么沉重，扛下它。

en.name: Fatal Bolts - Advancement
en.effect: Sniper Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
en.flavor: Load, aim, and fire. Destruction arrives as scheduled.

zh.name: 残弩-突破
zh.effect: 所有【狙击】干员的部署费用-2，生命+60%
zh.flavor: 上膛，瞄准，开火，毁灭如期而至。

en.name: Fatal Bolts - Divine Speed
en.effect: Sniper Operators have +70 ASPD
en.flavor: It is said that the legendary archers of ancient Victoria can almost shoot a continuous stream of arrows.

zh.name: 残弩-神速
zh.effect: 所有【狙击】干员的攻击速度+70
zh.flavor: 据说古维多利亚的传奇弓手可以让箭矢几乎连成一线。

en.name: Broken Wand - Advancement
en.effect: Caster Operators have -3 DP Cost and +60% HP
en.flavor: Let Arts dance around your fingertips. Call the wind and rain, unravel reality, and achieve your grand goals.

zh.name: 断杖-突破
zh.effect: 所有【术师】干员的部署费用-3，生命+60%
zh.flavor: 让技艺在指尖起舞，呼风唤雨，搅乱现实，达成你宏伟的目的。

en.name: Broken Wand - Undulation
en.effect: For each [Caster] Operator on the field, all enemies take +12% Arts Damage (stacks up to 8 times)
en.flavor: Tuned to the same frequency; together we'll play the melody.

zh.name: 断杖-波纹
zh.effect: 场上每有一名【术师】干员，所有敌人受到的法术伤害+12%（最多叠加8层）
zh.flavor: 调谐到同一频率，让我们奏起旋律。

en.name: Healer's Path - Self-Treating
en.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Medic Operators by +0.3/s
en.flavor: Who says healers can't heal themselves? They simply pop some pills before continuing to help others.

zh.name: 医者-自医
zh.effect: 所有【医疗】干员的技力恢复+0.3/秒
zh.flavor: 谁说医者不能自医，他们只是选择给自己来一片提神药然后继续帮助别人而已。

en.name: Healer's Path - Keen Hands
en.effect: Medic Operators gain +70 ASPD
en.flavor: Compared to snatching a life from the grip of death, what's three days of coma afterward?

zh.name: 医者-妙手
zh.effect: 所有【医疗】干员的攻击速度+70
zh.flavor: 比起从死亡手里多抢回一条命的伟业，事后昏睡个三天算什么？

en.name: Rusted Blade - Advancement
en.effect: Specialist Operators have -3 DP Cost and +60% Max HP
en.flavor: There may be many means, but only one end.

zh.name: 锈刃-突破
zh.effect: 所有【特种】干员的部署费用-3，生命+60%
zh.flavor: 手段有很多，结局却只有一种。

en.name: Rusted Blade - No Man's Land
en.effect: The Redeployment Time of Specialist Operators -35%
en.flavor: A shadow blinks, a faint sound stirs, and a life is taken. The audience is the next victim.

zh.name: 锈刃-可视静谧
zh.effect: 所有【特种】干员的再部署时间-35%
zh.flavor: 声音在阴影掠过的瞬间遇害，倾听它们的人将是下一位受害者。

en.name: Stalwart Aid - Advancement
en.effect: Supporter Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
en.flavor: Whenever you're 'almost done' with a task, what you need at that moment is someone to help you with the 'almost' part.

zh.name: 支柱-突破
zh.effect: 所有【辅助】干员的部署费用-2，生命+60%
zh.flavor: 当“差一点完成任务”的时候，你需要的正是那个帮你补上“差一点”的人。

en.name: Stalwart Aid - Assistance
en.effect: Allied units within the attack range of Supporter Operators gain +30% ATK
en.flavor: Proper meals, correct paths, or simply having a heart-to-heart... Victory is won through these little things.

zh.name: 支柱-援护
zh.effect: 所有【辅助】干员使攻击范围内的我方单位攻击力+30%
zh.flavor: 递上饭食、指明路线、甚至是促膝谈心，胜败的关键就在这点滴之间。

en.name: Stalwart Aid - Diligence
en.effect: The SP Cost of Supporter Operators' skills -40%
en.flavor: Operators tend to give it their all, even to tasks that might seem trivial. The reality is, those tasks are not trivial at all.

zh.name: 支柱-勤奋
zh.effect: 所有【辅助】干员的技力消耗-40%
zh.flavor: 即使是看似最微小的工作，干员们也会全力以赴。何况事实上，一点也不微小。

en.name: Blunt Claws - Initiative
en.effect: When a Vanguard Operator activates a skill, immediately gain 3 DP
en.flavor: Every second counts; the aim is to seize the advantageous position.

zh.name: 钝爪-先机
zh.effect: 先锋干员开启技能时，立刻获得3点部署费用
zh.flavor: 争分夺秒，志在夺取有利位置。

en.name: Bend Spears - Evasion
en.effect: Guard Operators have a 75% chance to dodge attacks from enemies outside their attack range
en.flavor: Retreating is not cowardice, but preparation for the next attack.

zh.name: 折戟-避锋
zh.effect: 近卫干员受到攻击范围外敌人的攻击时，有75%概率闪避
zh.flavor: 退避并非怯战，而是为了下一次攻击。

en.name: Iron Guard - Light Travel
en.effect: Defender Operators have -75% DP Cost for their first deployment
en.flavor: Having shed their cumbersome packs, the guardians remain as steadfast as ever.

zh.name: 铁卫-轻行
zh.effect: 重装干员首次部署费用-75%
zh.flavor: 丢掉繁琐的行囊后，守护者坚韧依旧。

en.name: Fatal Bolts - Pinpoint
en.effect: Sniper Operators deal 140% ATK when attacking enemies in a straight line in front of them
en.flavor: Locking onto targets in a straight line has always been a Sniper's strength; adding more firepower on top keeps it just as steady.

zh.name: 残弩-神准
zh.effect: 狙击干员攻击面前直线上的敌人时，攻击力提升至140%
zh.flavor: 锁定直线目标一直是狙击干员的强项，在此基础上，多加火力也照样稳健。

en.name: Broken Wand - Attunement
en.effect: For each Caster Operator on the field, Caster Operators gain 3 SP when their skill ends
en.flavor: "Your glory, your shame: I feel them as my own."

zh.name: 断杖-同调
zh.effect: 场上每有一名术师干员，术师干员技能结束时获得3点技力
zh.flavor: “你的荣耀，你的耻辱，我感同身受。”

en.name: Healer's Path - Positional Strategy
en.effect: Ground Operators within a Medic Operator's attack range gain +1 Block (stackable)
en.flavor: Other Operators always like to gather around the Medics to hear the healers explain their new plans for on-the-spot treatment.

zh.name: 医者-地缘策略
zh.effect: 医疗干员攻击范围内的地面干员阻挡数+1，可叠加
zh.flavor: 其他干员总是喜欢围绕在医疗干员身边，听医者讲述关于即时疗愈的新方案。

en.name: Rusted Blade - Execution
en.effect: Specialist Operators gain +50 ASPD and +50% ATK
en.flavor: An endless amount of rust to scrape off, and an endless amount of work.

zh.name: 锈刃-研磨
zh.effect: 所有【特种】干员的攻击速度+50，攻击力+50%
zh.flavor: 磨不完的锈迹，做不尽的工作。

en.name: Hand of Pioneering
en.effect: Pioneer, Charger, and Strategist Operators have -6 DP Cost and -50% SP cost; with Blunt Claws - Initiative, activating a skill restores 2 SP to other Operators on the field
en.flavor: Strike first, and seize the initiative.

zh.name: 开拓之手
zh.effect: 尖兵、冲锋手、策士的部署费用-6，技力需求-50%；拥有钝爪-先机时，开启技能会给其他场上干员回复2点技力
zh.flavor: 先发制人，抢占先机。

en.name: Hand of Slaughter
en.effect: Musha, Dreadnought, and Arts Fighter Operators deal 200% damage to enemies in the four adjacent tiles; with Bend Spears - Evasion, defeating an enemy reduces their next Redeployment Time and DP Cost by 50%
en.flavor: Crushing all before them, strength enough to uproot mountains.

zh.name: 诛戮之手
zh.effect: 武者、无畏者、术战者对周围四格敌人造成的伤害提升至200%；拥有折戟-避锋时，击倒敌人后下次再部署时间和部署费用-50%
zh.flavor: 摧枯拉朽，力拔山兮。

en.name: Hand of Steadfast Defense
en.effect: Protector, Sentry Protector, and Juggernaut Operators gain +100% ATK and Max HP on deployment and after their skill ends, decaying over 60 seconds; with Iron Guard - Light Travel, they gain +3 Block while above 50% HP
en.flavor: Hold fast, and resist to the very end.

zh.name: 坚御之手
zh.effect: 铁卫、哨戒铁卫、不屈者部署时和技能结束后攻击力和最大生命+100%，加成在60秒内递减；拥有铁卫-轻行时，生命高于50%时阻挡数+3
zh.flavor: 坚守不移，抵抗到底。

en.name: Hand of Sky Dominion
en.effect: Artilleryman, Spreadshooter, and Skybreaker Operators gain +150% ATK for 5 seconds when activating a skill; with Fatal Bolts - Pinpoint, gain 3 SP every 3 seconds
en.flavor: I face the heavens, and scorn the clear blue sky.

zh.name: 慑空之手
zh.effect: 炮手、散射手、裂空炮手开启技能时攻击力+150%，持续5秒；拥有残弩-神准时，每3秒获得3点技力
zh.flavor: 我自向天，藐视晴苍。

en.name: Hand of Undulation
en.effect: Blast Caster, Chain Caster, and Mech-Accord Caster Operators recover 2 SP each time they deal damage to a unit; with Broken Wand - Attunement, they gain +20% ATK for 3 seconds after dealing damage (up to +100%)
en.flavor: Blasts conquer, the wake deafening.

zh.name: 波纹之手
zh.effect: 轰击术师、链术师、驭械术师每对一个单位造成伤害就回复2点技力值，拥有断杖-同调时，造成伤害后3秒内攻击力+20%（最高+100%）
zh.flavor: 一扫而过，震耳欲聋。

en.name: Hand of Healing Care
en.effect: Allied Operators within the attack range of Therapist, Wandering Medic, and Abjurer Operators are immune to status effects; with Healer's Path - Positional Strategy, overhealing converts into an equal Barrier (up to 100% of Max HP)
en.flavor: Treat others as you would yourself, and care for them always.

zh.name: 护愈之手
zh.effect: 疗养师、行医、护佑者攻击范围内的我方干员免疫异常状态，拥有医者-地缘策略时，溢出的治疗量可以转化成等量的屏障（最大为100%生命上限）
zh.flavor: 将心比心，时刻呵护。

en.name: Hand of Ambush
en.effect: When an enemy enters the attack range of a Mystic Caster, Deadeye, or Hunter Operator, it takes one hit of Arts or Physical Damage equal to 300% ATK and gains 50% Arts or Physical Fragility (3 seconds)
en.flavor: Within their sight, not a blade of grass survives.
en.unlock: Select 'Tactical Ranged Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 剿袭之手
zh.effect: 敌人进入秘术师、神射手、猎手的攻击范围内时，受到一次攻击力300%的法术或物理伤害和50%的法术或物理脆弱（持续3秒）
zh.flavor: 视域之内，寸草不生。
zh.unlock: 选择【远程战术分队】完成游戏结局

en.name: Blunt Claws - New Doctrine
en.effect: Immediately promote one [Vanguard] Operator (without spending Hope), and it gains +10% ATK each time it activates a skill (up to +60%)
en.flavor: A powerful new set of equipment, and a heart even more determined to forge ahead.

zh.name: 钝爪-新典训
zh.effect: 立即进阶一个【先锋】干员（不消耗希望），并使其：每次开启技能后攻击力+10%（最多+60%）
zh.flavor: 一套新的强力装备，一颗更加勇往直前的心。

en.name: Broken Wand - New Doctrine
en.effect: Immediately promote one [Caster] Operator (without spending Hope), and its attacks reduce the target's RES by 5 (up to 25)
en.flavor: "I found a Leithanien textbook in the trash. Did one of the Operators lose it by accident?"

zh.name: 断杖-新典训
zh.effect: 立即进阶一个【术师】干员（不消耗希望），并使其：攻击时降低目标5点法术抗性（最多降低25）
zh.flavor: “我在垃圾桶里看到一本莱塔尼亚教材，是哪位干员不小心丢失的吗？”

en.name: Bend Spears - New Doctrine
en.effect: Immediately promote one [Guard] Operator (without spending Hope), and it restores 100% HP the first time it is defeated
en.flavor: At a hundred paces, bolts and Arts are faster. But within three steps, the sword is faster still.

zh.name: 折戟-新典训
zh.effect: 立即进阶一个【近卫】干员（不消耗希望），并使其：首次被击倒时回复100%生命
zh.flavor: 百步之外，弩箭与法术更快，但三步之内，还是剑更快。

en.name: Iron Guard - New Doctrine
en.effect: Immediately promote one [Defender] Operator (without spending Hope), and it recovers 2 SP when attacked
en.flavor: Fallen warriors have become scratches, forever remembered upon the sturdy shield.

zh.name: 铁卫-新典训
zh.effect: 立即进阶一个【重装】干员（不消耗希望），并使其：受到攻击时回复2技力
zh.flavor: 逝去的战士已成为划痕，永远被铭记于坚盾之上。

en.name: Fatal Bolts - New Doctrine
en.effect: Immediately promote one [Sniper] Operator (without spending Hope), and its attacks ignore 50% of the target's DEF
en.flavor: "Missing isn't about your aim. Turn up the firepower and go again!"

zh.name: 残弩-新典训
zh.effect: 立即进阶一个【狙击】干员（不消耗希望），并使其：攻击时无视目标50%的防御
zh.flavor: “没射中不是你准头不行，给我加大火力，再来！”

en.name: Healer's Path - New Doctrine
en.effect: Immediately promote one [Medic] Operator (without spending Hope), and its heals grant the target 2 SP
en.flavor: "I became a Medic hoping no one would ever need to come to me for treatment again. If that puts me out of a job, I'll gladly take it."

zh.name: 医者-新典训
zh.effect: 立即进阶一个【医疗】干员（不消耗希望），并使其：治疗时使目标获得2技力
zh.flavor: “我成为医疗干员的初衷是希望没有人再来找我看病，如果失业我也是心甘情愿的。”

en.name: Rusted Blade - New Doctrine
en.effect: Immediately promote one [Specialist] Operator (without spending Hope), and it has -50% Redeployment Time
en.flavor: Even veterans who regularly spar with Specialists still can't quite judge the moment to "get ready to be hit".

zh.name: 锈刃-新典训
zh.effect: 立即进阶一个【特种】干员（不消耗希望），并使其：再部署时间-50%
zh.flavor: 即便是经常与特种干员进行实战练习的老手，依然无法精准把握“准备好被打”的时机。

en.name: Stalwart Aid - New Doctrine
en.effect: Immediately promote one [Supporter] Operator (without spending Hope), and enemies within its attack range have -40% DEF and RES
en.flavor: Don't try to assign Supporters their positions. Their own tactics usually work better than any plan drawn up in advance.

zh.name: 支柱-新典训
zh.effect: 立即进阶一个【辅助】干员（不消耗希望），并使其：攻击范围内的敌人防御力和法术抗性-40%
zh.flavor: 别试图为辅助干员指定行动点位，他们自己的策略往往比制定好的计划更有效。

en.name: Convalescence Gift Card
en.effect: The next Operator recruited or promoted gains +50 ASPD
en.flavor: The Convalescence Courtyard always welcomes Operators who want to unwind with friends.

zh.name: 疗养礼品卡
zh.effect: 下一个招募或进阶的干员攻击速度+50
zh.flavor: 疗养庭院永远欢迎想和朋友一起来放松身心的干员。

en.name: Wolf Between Fingers
en.effect: The next Operator recruited or promoted cannot activate skills, but gains +100% ATK and +50 ASPD
en.flavor: This savage style of brawling is gradually being banned on Siracusan streets; catching a thrilling "wolf fight" these days isn't easy.

zh.name: 指中狼
zh.effect: 下一个招募或进阶的干员无法开启技能，但攻击力+100%，攻击速度+50
zh.flavor: 这种野蛮的斗殴方式在叙拉古街头被逐渐取缔，现在想要观赏一场酣畅淋漓的“狼斗”并非易事。

en.name: "Mama's Encouragement"
en.effect: The next Operator recruited or promoted gains +50% ATK on its first deployment
en.flavor: Mama John's best-selling energy bar, which solved the low blood sugar of most Operators who skip breakfast. They say each wrapper carries a different encouraging message to start a brand-new day.

zh.name: “老妈的鼓励”
zh.effect: 下一个招募或进阶的干员首次部署时攻击力+50%
zh.flavor: 约翰老妈旗下最畅销的能量棒，解决了大部分不爱吃早餐的干员低血糖的问题。据说每一根的包装内都有不同的鼓励语，用于开启崭新的一天。

en.name: Expanding Foam
en.effect: The next Operator recruited or promoted has -50 ASPD but +120% ATK
en.flavor: "So it was your foam you didn't put away that tripped me?! My shoe's glued to the floor, don't you run—"

zh.name: 发泡胶
zh.effect: 下一个招募或进阶的干员攻击速度-50，攻击力+120%
zh.flavor: “就是你没收好的发泡胶绊了我一脚？！我鞋被粘在地上了，别跑——”

en.name: Snack Box
en.effect: The next Operator recruited or promoted has its skills activate automatically and -20% SP cost
en.flavor: "I think I accidentally found the Doctor's secret stash—"

zh.name: 零食盒
zh.effect: 下一个招募或进阶的干员的技能会自动开启，技力需求-20%
zh.flavor: “我好像一不小心发现了博士的小金库——”

en.name: Serene Diffuser Stone
en.effect: All Operators within the attack range of the next Operator recruited or promoted gain 1 SP every 3 seconds
en.flavor: A choice of sleep-inducing scents. Just one drop, and sweet dreams are yours.

zh.name: 静谧扩香石
zh.effect: 下一个招募或进阶的干员攻击范围内的所有干员每3秒获得1点技力
zh.flavor: 多种助眠香型可选，只需一滴，即享美梦。

en.name: Fortune Cookie
en.effect: On obtaining this collectible, 2 random Operators gain +0.8/s SP recovery
en.flavor: Cookies with a note from the Doctor tucked inside; any Operator who gets a note can have the Doctor grant a small wish. By incomplete count, the Doctor has received at least dozens of notes with smudged writing, about as many as the cookies handed out.

zh.name: 幸运饼干
zh.effect: 获得此收藏品时，使随机2名干员的技力回复速度+0.8/秒
zh.flavor: 塞着博士寄语纸条的饼干，吃到纸条的干员可以让博士满足一个小心愿。据不完全统计，博士至少已经收到几十张字迹被洇湿的纸条了——数量和发出去的小饼干不相上下。

en.name: Rhodes Island Tactical Transceiver
en.effect: Gain an additional choice when Recruitment Vouchers are dropped after battle
en.flavor: Hang in there, help's on the way.
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recruit a total of 70 Operators

zh.name: 罗德岛战术电台
zh.effect: 战斗后掉落招募券时，增加一个可选项
zh.flavor: 保持联络，支援马上抵达。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计招募总共70名干员

en.name: Ancient Tree Fruit
en.effect: Immediately obtain 3 random trinkets
en.flavor: The children of Sami make their wishes into tree seeds and bury them in the snow. When the tree bears fruit, the first four are taken, and the smallest is left to the next generation for wish making. The rest are tributes to Sami for hearing their questions.
en.unlock: Complete an adventure with the [Geological Survey Squad]

zh.name: 古地树实
zh.effect: 立即获得三件随机的小玩意
zh.flavor: 萨米的孩子将愿望许进树种里埋入皑皑白雪。待到大树结实，取下前四个果实，将最小的那个留给后代许愿，余下的树果，便是向萨米祈求答案的贡品。
zh.unlock: 选择【地质调查分队】完成游戏结局

en.name: Children of the Walls
en.effect: Operators deployed on the 8 tiles surrounding the Objective Point gain +2 Block and +50% Max HP
en.flavor: The Children of Soil and Stone carefully taught the ancient city of Kazdel how to toughen itself and protect its people behind its walls. With the advent of a protracted peace, it was broken into many little pieces and turned into amulets for adventurers heading into unexplored lands.

zh.name: 城墙之子
zh.effect: 部署在蓝色目标点周围8格的干员阻挡数+2，最大生命值+50%
zh.flavor: 土石之子精心培育了卡兹戴尔的古老城垣，教会了它如何使自己变得刚韧，以保护身后的人民。随着长久和平的时代到来，它被拆分成了许多小块，作为护身符赠给了前往未知之地的探险家们。

en.name: Golden Chalice
en.effect: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all friendly units have +7 ASPD
en.flavor: Saints, knights, and believers. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!
en.unlock: Have your reserve balance in the Prospective Investment System reach 250 at its peak

zh.name: 金酒之杯
zh.effect: 每有5源石锭，所有我方单位的攻击速度+7
zh.flavor: 圣人、骑士、虔信之徒，无人不为之疯狂。老天啊，连杯子本身都是纯金的！
zh.unlock: 在“前瞻性投资系统”中的投资储备余额最高达到过250

en.name: Roundstone Altar
en.effect: Chance to permanently increase all allied units' ATK and DEF by 5% after a battle (Stacks up to 10 times)
en.flavor: An offering made is returned with a reward. So simple it was, that people never questioned what they were sacrificing to.

zh.name: 圆石祭坛
zh.effect: 战斗后有概率使所有我方单位的攻击力和防御力永久+5%（最多叠加10层）
zh.flavor: 送上祭品，获得回馈。它是如此地便利，以至于人们都没有思考过，他们到底在向什么献祭。

en.name: Rusted Iron Hammer
en.effect: Items in shops cost -50% Originium Ingots
en.flavor: 'Change is necessary, and we must do all we can to hasten the oncoming storm.'

zh.name: 锈蚀的铁锤
zh.effect: 在商店中购买道具所需源石锭-50%
zh.flavor: “变革是必须的，而我们应当让暴风雨来得更快一点。”

en.name: Four-Leaf Clover Fossil
en.effect: Gain an additional choice when loot drops from a Wish Fulfilled node or after battle
en.flavor: A symbol of luck that Magallan found in a place all but devoid of life. The rock has no doubt experienced many violent changes of the lands, but it survived, giving those who come across it a small bit of lingering hope.
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, obtain 100 Collectibles

zh.name: 四叶草化石
zh.effect: 我方在得偿所愿节点和战斗后掉落战利品时，增加一个可选项
zh.flavor: 麦哲伦在生命绝迹之所找到的幸运象征。这块石头无疑经历过大地的剧变，但它还是幸存下来，将残留的小小希望留给了发现它的人。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计获得收藏品100次

en.name: 'Fist Classics 123'
en.effect: Operators gain +5% ATK whenever they use a skill (Stacks up to 40 times)
en.flavor: Shuo's first collection of his thoughts on Kung Fu. It discusses three aspects: first, fist techniques; second, meaning; and third, the pugilist realm itself. It is said the language used is so cryptic that his students could not understand it, so he asked his younger sister for revisions.
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 20 battles.

zh.name: 《拳经三问》
zh.effect: 干员每使用过一次技能，自身的攻击力+5%，最多叠加40层
zh.flavor: 朔的第一本武学笔记，记录了他对拳法的思考。一问拳招，二问拳意，三问武境。据说言语晦涩，学生苦读不懂，他向妹妹请教后又做了改良。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计胜利20场战斗

en.name: Mercenary's Accessory
en.effect: Grants a random Operator +5% ATK, DEF, and Max HP, plus an additional +5% after each perfectly cleared battle (Stacks up to 10 times)
en.flavor: A small price to pay for pursuing perfection. Small because it hasn't really affected his reading and writing.

zh.name: 佣兵的饰物
zh.effect: 使随机一名干员的攻击力、防御力、最大生命值+5%，且每次完美作战结束后额外+5%（最多叠加10层）
zh.flavor: 那是他为了追求尽善尽美所付出的一点微小代价。说微小，是因为他的阅读和写作都未受多少影响。

en.name: Light Pack
en.effect: Parts Crate capacity +4
en.flavor: "If only we could fill our bellies just standing still."

zh.name: 薄行囊
zh.effect: 零件箱容量+4
zh.flavor: “如果我们站着不动也能填饱肚子就好了。”

en.name: Sorrowful Red
en.effect: For each Part in the Parts Crate, all Operators gain +8% Max HP and ATK
en.flavor: She watches us from the branches; our bones, our ashes, all mingled together.

zh.name: 悲伤的红
zh.effect: 零件箱中每有1个零件，所有干员的生命和攻击力+8%
zh.flavor: 她在枝头望着我们，我们的骨骼、我们的骨灰，都混在了一起。

en.name: Empty Bed
en.effect: While the Parts Crate has 4 or more empty slots, all Operators have -6 DP Cost
en.flavor: Two people cast three shadows; the souls are crowded beyond bearing.

zh.name: 空床
zh.effect: 零件箱中存在4个或更多空栏位时，所有干员部署费用-6
zh.flavor: 两人投下三枚阴影，灵魂拥挤不堪。

en.name: Hide-and-Seek
en.effect: Each time you enter a new Area, mark one node; exploring it grants a fairly rare random Natural Object
en.flavor: Hide an acorn, so that all things will know us.

zh.name: 迷藏
zh.effect: 每次进入新区域时标记一个节点，探索该节点后获得一个较为稀有的随机自然物
zh.flavor: 藏起一颗橡实，以便让万物都认得我们。

en.name: Wheel Regained
en.effect: When a Crafted Item runs out of uses, gain a random Crafted Item
en.flavor: We are going to intercept a tree stump that is running away.

zh.name: 复得之轮
zh.effect: 加工品使用次数耗尽时，获得一个随机加工品
zh.flavor: 我们将要去截获，一段飞奔而逃的树桩。

en.name: Sated
en.effect: A Crafted Item's last move no longer costs Action Points
en.flavor: The fruit strikes me like hammers; every bruise is the shape of your greed.

zh.name: 果腹
zh.effect: 加工品的最后一次移动不再消耗行动力
zh.flavor: 果实如锤砸在我身，每一块淤青都是你贪婪的形状。

en.name: Bones in a Pouch
en.effect: Immediately gain 3 random common Crafted Items
en.flavor: Its life was so short that it never left the bed that nurtured it, even in death.

zh.name: 囊中骨
zh.effect: 立刻获得3个随机的普通加工品
zh.flavor: 它的生命如此短暂，到死都没有离开孕育它的温床。

en.name: Little Hands in the Forest
en.effect: Immediately gain 3 random common Natural Objects
en.flavor: A plant that symbolizes good fortune. Superstitious Bolivarians believe that whoever comes across little hands in the forest will immediately come into wealth.

zh.name: 林中小手
zh.effect: 立刻获得3个随机的普通自然物
zh.flavor: 象征吉兆的植物，迷信的玻利瓦尔人相信，遇到林中小手后会立刻获得财富。

en.name: Blood Children
en.effect: Gain the Natural Object <Withered Moss Ball> until the Parts Crate is full
en.flavor: "I have many, many children, but fewer and fewer grandchildren."

zh.name: 血孩子
zh.effect: 获得自然物<枯苔藓球>，直到零件箱被填满
zh.flavor: “我有很多很多的孩子，但孙辈却越来越少。”

en.name: Fellow Traveler
en.effect: Recruiting in Emergency Aid nodes costs -50% Originium Ingots, and Emergency Operators gain +40% Max HP, ATK, and DEF
en.flavor: "You're one of us now. Let's get to know each other's scent."

zh.name: 同行者
zh.effect: 应急助力节点中招募所需源石锭-50%，应急干员的生命值、攻击力和防御力+40%
zh.flavor: “现在你是我们的一员了，让我们熟悉彼此的气味。”

en.name: Ill-Fated Fire Rod
en.effect: In operations against "Residents", enemies have -40% Max HP, and after winning, all Operators permanently gain +10 ASPD
en.flavor: The "Residents" wave their clubs and stones, not yet knowing they're no match for a stick that smokes.

zh.name: 厄运火杆
zh.effect: 与“居民”作战时，敌人生命-40%，且作战胜利后所有干员的攻击速度永久+10
zh.flavor: “居民”们挥舞着手里的棍棒和石头，还不知道自己对付不了会冒烟的杆子。

en.name: Hunt Mark
en.effect: Hound Proto has -50% ATK; for each stack of [Pathfinder Vanguard], allied units gain +10 RES
en.flavor: This is not the Beast Lord's fear, merely a moment's respite It grants you.

zh.name: 猎印
zh.effect: 猎犬proto的攻击力-50%；每拥有1层【探测先锋】，我方法术抗性+10
zh.flavor: 这并非兽主的恐惧，只是祂施舍给你的片刻喘息。

en.name: Originium Private Key
en.effect: Immediately gain 99 Originium Ingots; has special uses in certain events
en.flavor: A precious access card. Remember: it bends to your will.

zh.name: 源私钥
zh.effect: 立刻获得99源石锭，在部分事件中能发挥特殊的作用
zh.flavor: 一张珍贵的权限卡片，记住，它会以你的意志为转移。

en.name: Blackstream Treesea Notes
en.effect: Gain 1 stack for each new node type explored; each stack increases the chance of obtaining collectibles after operations
en.flavor: A notebook added to again and again; the different handwriting on its pages shows it has changed hands many times. It seems to be forever waiting for its next recorder.

zh.name: 黑流树海笔记
zh.effect: 每探索一种新节点叠加1层，每层使作战后获得收藏品的概率提升
zh.flavor: 一本被反复增加过内容的笔记本，纸张上不同的字体说明它已几经易手。它似乎永远在等待着下一位记录者。

en.name: Decorative Paradox
en.effect: When discarding a Part, gain Originium Ingots equal to 50% of its value
en.flavor: This... "creature" looks a little familiar. Maybe you've seen its scrap parts somewhere, or maybe a similar design.

zh.name: 装饰性佯谬
zh.effect: 丢弃零件时，获得等于其价值50%的源石锭
zh.flavor: 你觉得这个……“生物”有点眼熟，或许是因为在哪见过它身上的废弃零件，又或许是见过类似的造型设计。

en.name: "Cocktail Needle"
en.effect: Each time a Pursuit is triggered, all allied Operators gain +20 ASPD
en.flavor: This hound-specific blood-sampling pen seems to have been designed with a syringe function built in. Be sure to follow the instructions exactly.

zh.name: “鸡尾酒针”
zh.effect: 每触发一次追猎，我方所有干员攻速+20
zh.flavor: 这种猎犬专用的采血笔设计时似乎还融合了注射器的功能，请务必遵照说明书进行规范操作。

en.name: Old Feathered Serpent
en.effect: Ground Operators gain +20% Max HP, and no single hit can deal more than 60% of their Max HP
en.flavor: A curious clay figure that stands back up however hard it's knocked down. One expert claimed it was a two-thousand-year-old Columbian artifact and was laughed at by his Feathered Serpent colleagues.

zh.name: 羽蛇翁
zh.effect: 地面干员生命上限+20%，且单次受到的伤害不会超过最大生命值的60%
zh.flavor: 不管被多大的力气击倒都会重新站起来的奇妙土偶。有专家称这是两千年前的哥伦比亚文物，受到了同行羽蛇神民的耻笑。

en.name: Duck Pressure Plate
en.effect: Originium Ingots +6; Rogue Trader and Secret Realm Trader nodes are revealed directly
en.flavor: Just step on it and wait a few seconds, and you'll get a shopping list tailored to your personal needs. No one can resist recommendations this personal.

zh.name: 鸭力板
zh.effect: 源石锭+6，诡意行商和秘境行商节点直接揭露视野
zh.flavor: 只要站上去，等待几秒，就能得到一份针对你的个人需求量身打造的购物单。无人能抵抗这种贴身定制的商品推荐。

en.name: Treesea VIP Package
en.effect: For every 5 points of valuation in the Parts Storage, Operators gain +3% Max HP (up to +150%)
en.flavor: "Your worth determines your safety, as it should. And we will certainly do our utmost not to let our clients leave us."

zh.name: 树海贵宾套餐
zh.effect: 零件仓库每有5点估值，干员生命上限+3%（最多+150%）
zh.flavor: “您的身价会决定您的生命安全，理当如此。我们也定会尽最大的努力，不让客户离我们而去。”

en.name: "Go Set Foot"
en.effect: If every node in the current Area has been revealed, immediately gain some Originium Ingots
en.flavor: Trending: Unknown mysterious life found in the Blackstream Treesea? Excavated relics point to a legendary lost ancient civilization? The expedition team welcomes qualified volunteers!

zh.name: 《去踏足》
zh.effect: 若本区域节点的视野全部揭露，立刻获得一定数量的源石锭
zh.flavor: 热议：黑流树海中发现未知神秘生命？出土文物指向传说中失落的古代文明？探险队欢迎有识之士的加入！

en.name: Suspicious Stamp Card
en.effect: For each type of non-combat node visited, Originium Ingots dropped in battle +10%
en.flavor: Some "Residents" eagerly stamp this card, while others want to snatch it. But what actually happens once it's full? And who do you redeem it with?

zh.name: 可疑的集点卡
zh.effect: 每去过一种类型的非战斗节点，战斗掉落的源石锭+10%
zh.flavor: 一些“居民”热心地在这张集点卡上盖下印章，而另一些则想抢走它。但是集满以后到底会发生什么？又该向谁去兑换它？

en.name: Familiar Go Bowl
en.effect: Deployment Limit +1; gain a number of Emergency Operators when entering the next Area
en.flavor: This is definitely not an illusion: aren't there more and more stones in the bowl? Then again... they're actually kind of cute?

zh.name: 似曾相识棋盒
zh.effect: 可同时部署人数+1，进入下一区域时，获得一定数量的应急干员
zh.flavor: 这肯定不是错觉，棋盒里的棋子是不是越来越多了？不过……其实它们还挺可爱的？

en.name: Basic IoT Terminal
en.effect: Gain [Advanced IoT Terminal] after exploring 2 Rogue Trader or Secret Realm Trader nodes
en.flavor: Said to be a terminal device that connects all things, so being of one mind with everything is no longer a problem. Don't you want to know what your fridge is thinking?
en.unlock: Reach an ending 10 times

zh.name: 基础物联终端
zh.effect: 探索2个诡意行商或秘境行商后，获得【高级物联终端】
zh.flavor: 据说是一个可将万物连接起来的终端设备，从此与万物心意相通不再是问题。你难道不想知道你家的冰箱在想什么吗？
zh.unlock: 通关结局10次

en.name: Advanced IoT Terminal
en.effect: After deployment, an Operator links to one Operator within its attack range via the Advanced IoT Terminal; enemies touching the link are halted and take Arts Damage equal to 50% of the combined ATK of all linked Operators every 0.5 seconds
en.flavor: A modified terminal whose connection range has grown exponentially. Just raise the receiver pole to experience instant mind-to-mind connection!

zh.name: 高级物联终端
zh.effect: 干员部署后与攻击范围内一名干员用高级物联终端连接，敌人触碰高级物联终端时停顿，每0.5秒受到所有相连的干员攻击力之和50%的法术伤害
zh.flavor: 经过改造的终端，可连接范围指数级扩大，立起接收杆即可立刻体验心意相通！

en.name: Plant Sap
en.effect: Gain [Hound Plant Sap] after completing 1 [Pursuit] operation
en.flavor: A simple potion made from the sap of Blackstream Treesea trees that can mask your scent.

zh.name: 植浆
zh.effect: 完成1场【追猎】作战后，获得【犬植浆】
zh.flavor: 以黑流树海中的树木汁液为基底制作的简易药水，可以掩盖自身的气味。

en.name: Hound Plant Sap
en.effect: Other Operators within an Operator's attack range gain Camouflage and +10% ATK (stackable)
en.flavor: Plant sap mixed with hound blood, which masks your scent as completely as possible.

zh.name: 犬植浆
zh.effect: 干员攻击范围内的其他干员获得迷彩，攻击力+10%（可叠加）
zh.flavor: 混入了猎犬血液的植浆，可以最大程度掩盖自身的气味。

en.name: Remembrance
en.effect: When entering the next Area, you instead re-enter the current Area; this collectible then becomes inactive
en.flavor: Following the black stream, I will return to the swaddling cloth still warm, to the days of old when this land could still be called an "infant".

zh.name: 追忆
zh.effect: 进入下一区域时，变为重新进入本区域，之后该收藏品失效
zh.flavor: 顺着黑流，我将回到尚有余温的襁褓，回到这片大地仍可被唤作“婴孩”的旧日时光。

en.name: Rappel Raid Device
en.effect: Allied Operators have -50% Redeployment Time, and on deployment deal Physical Damage equal to 1000% ATK to a random enemy and enemies in the 8 tiles around it
en.flavor: The Columbian military's latest mobile gear, letting special forces drop from the sky and strike key strategic targets in an instant! "We can solve every problem on this land this way. Fantastic!"
en.unlock: Reach an ending 10 times

zh.name: 垂降劫掠装置
zh.effect: 我方干员的再部署时间-50%，部署时对随机1名敌人及周围8格的敌人造成攻击力1000%的物理伤害
zh.flavor: 哥伦比亚军方最新研发的机动装备，能让特种兵们从天而降，一瞬间完成对重要战略目标的打击！“我们可以用这种方式解决大地上的一切麻烦，真是太棒了！”
zh.unlock: 通关结局10次

en.name: List of Grudges
en.effect: Allied Operators gain +2% ATK, plus a permanent additional +0.2% for each enemy defeated (up to +200%)
en.flavor: It belongs to a nameless Yan swordsman. "Always one short."

zh.name: 仇名录
zh.effect: 我方干员的攻击力+2%，每击倒一名敌人永久额外+0.2%（最高+200%）
zh.flavor: 它属于一位没有名字的大炎剑客。“永远都差一个。”

en.name: Sand Table α
en.effect: Allied units have +2 DP Cost; leads the expedition in a different direction; while also holding [Sand Table β], reveals Yuan Jiefang's location
en.flavor: Special intelligence from the Meland Foundation, highly classified. The area shown on the sand table seems extremely hard to penetrate; perhaps she can only be found by cross-referencing the other party's clues.
en.unlock: Complete an adventure.

zh.name: 沙盘α
zh.effect: 我方单位部署费用+2，让探索开启不同的方向，同时持有【沙盘β】可以揭示源阶方的所在位置
zh.flavor: 来自梅兰德基金会的特殊信息，保密等级相当高。沙盘上显示的区域似乎极难深入，或许只能根据另一方的线索二次定位后找到她。
zh.unlock: 完成游戏结局

en.name: Sand Table β
en.effect: Allied units have +3 DP Cost; leads the expedition in a different direction; while also holding [Sand Table α], reveals Yuan Jiefang's location
en.flavor: Special intelligence from the Union Government, highly classified. The area shown on the sand table seems extremely hard to penetrate; perhaps she can only be found by cross-referencing the other party's clues.
en.unlock: Complete an adventure.

zh.name: 沙盘β
zh.effect: 我方单位部署费用+3，让探索开启不同的方向，同时持有【沙盘α】可以揭示源阶方的所在位置
zh.flavor: 来自联合政府的特殊信息，保密等级相当高。沙盘上显示的区域似乎极难深入，或许只能根据另一方的线索二次定位后找到她。
zh.unlock: 完成游戏结局

en.name: Heartbeat Beacon
en.effect: All enemies gain +20% Max HP, allied units have -40% Max HP; leads the expedition in a different direction
en.flavor: A heart under constant monitoring that seems to be draining your strength. Turned toward a certain direction, it begins to beat faintly.
en.unlock: Complete an adventure.

zh.name: 怦然信标
zh.effect: 所有敌人的生命+20%，我方单位的生命-40%，让探索开启不同的方向
zh.flavor: 一颗被时刻监测着的心脏，似乎正在夺走你的力量。调整至某个方向后，它微弱地跳动了起来。
zh.unlock: 完成游戏结局

en.name: Shoot Down the "Gods"
en.effect: In a special node, prevents "Bolivar, Crux of the Malady" from destroying "Decay" the first time it uses "Maw of Calamity"
en.flavor: Log: Unconfirmed anomalous entity intrusion. Unexpected error. Destruction of residents and buildings detected, severely detrimental to future development. Priority: ensure the utopia runs according to the original plan. Intercept the target.
en.unlock: Complete an adventure.

zh.name: 击坠“神明”
zh.effect: 可以在特殊节点中，使“玻利瓦尔，症结之核”首次释放“灾厄之口”时不摧毁“危朽”
zh.flavor: 日志：未确认的异常个体入侵，非预期的错误。监测到对居民与建筑的破坏行为，严重不利于后续发展，优先确保乌托邦依照原计划正常运行，阻击目标。
zh.unlock: 完成游戏结局

en.name: Extinguish the "Light"
en.effect: In a special node, reduces the damage of "Bolivar, Crux of the Malady"'s "Maw of Calamity"
en.flavor: Log: Unconfirmed anomalous entity intrusion. Unexpected error. Unnatural disasters running rampant detected, severely detrimental to future development. Priority: ensure the utopia runs according to the original plan. Intercept the target.
en.unlock: Complete an adventure.

zh.name: 湮没“光明”
zh.effect: 可以在特殊节点中，使“玻利瓦尔，症结之核”的“灾厄之口”伤害降低
zh.flavor: 日志：未确认的异常个体入侵，非预期的错误。监测到非自然的灾害肆虐，严重不利于后续发展，优先确保乌托邦依照原计划正常运行，阻击目标。
zh.unlock: 完成游戏结局

en.name: Burn Down "Civilization"
en.effect: In a special node, prevents "Bolivar, Crux of the Malady"'s "Maw of Calamity" from sealing the deployment area
en.flavor: Log: Unconfirmed anomalous entity intrusion. Unexpected error. Interference with the foundations of cognition detected, severely detrimental to future development. Priority: ensure the utopia runs according to the original plan. Intercept the target.
en.unlock: Complete an adventure.

zh.name: 焚毁“文明”
zh.effect: 可以在特殊节点中，使“玻利瓦尔，症结之核”的“灾厄之口”无法封锁待部署区
zh.flavor: 日志：未确认的异常个体入侵，非预期的错误。监测到对认知根基的干涉，严重不利于后续发展，优先确保乌托邦依照原计划正常运行，阻击目标。
zh.unlock: 完成游戏结局

en.name: Prayer to the Sun
en.effect: The Path of the Extinguished Sun appears in Area III, the Crimson Hollow Vein, and later Areas; Explorers appear in battles on the Path of the Extinguished Sun; Dreadful Foes in the Crimson Hollow Vein become more difficult
en.flavor: The beginning is already the end. The sun is eternal and undying; it stands apart from heaven and earth. The everlasting fire will show the way; our longing itself is the utopia.
en.unlock: After [Expansion I], complete an adventure

zh.name: 谒日之祈
zh.effect: 区域III血色空脉及后续区域中出现熄日余径，探险者会出现在熄日余径的战斗中，血色空脉中的险路恶敌变得更加艰难
zh.flavor: 起始已是终结。太阳恒久不灭，它超然于天地之外。永火将指引方向，我们的渴求本身即为乌托邦。
zh.unlock: 【内容拓展 · 一】后，完成一次游戏结局

en.name: Pact of the Sun's Sacrifice
en.effect: The Path of the Extinguished Sun no longer appears; all Operators have +50% Redeployment Time, and Crafted Items are destroyed after being used to move; leads the expedition in a different direction
en.flavor: The end is also the beginning. The sun has gone out; it lies dormant within living things. The new fire waits to be fed; the utopia's longing itself is us.
en.unlock: After [Expansion I], complete an adventure

zh.name: 祭日之契
zh.effect: 不再出现熄日余径，所有干员再部署时间+50%，使用加工品移动后使其损毁；让探索开启不同的方向
zh.flavor: 终结亦是起始。太阳已然熄灭，它蛰伏于生灵体内。新火在等待浇灌，乌托邦的渴求本身即为我们。
zh.unlock: 【内容拓展 · 一】后，完成一次游戏结局

en.name: Shattered Omen
en.effect: Explorers reappear in battles on the Path of the Extinguished Sun
en.flavor: Log: Unexpected forced awakening... discarded utopia proposal abnormally restarted. Priority: ensure— severe damage sustained, record core corrupted...
en.unlock: After [Expansion I], complete an adventure

zh.name: 破碎噩兆
zh.effect: 探险者重新出现在熄日余径的战斗中
zh.flavor: 日志：非预期的强制唤醒……乌托邦废案被异常重启。优先确保——遭受重创，记录核心已损坏……
zh.unlock: 【内容拓展 · 一】后，完成一次游戏结局

en.name: Blueprint of Life
en.effect: Enemy units gain +30% ATK and Movement Speed and +50% Max HP; Elite and Leader enemies take -50% Physical and Arts Damage for 30 seconds after appearing; Dreadful Foes in What the Blind See gain additional enemies
en.flavor: Why would there be such a strange blueprint in the jungle, and what language are the annotations in? What about the bizarre creature it depicts? Could the rumors of life from beyond the sky descending on the Blackstream Treesea be true?
en.unlock: After [Expansion I], complete an adventure

zh.name: 生命蓝图
zh.effect: 敌方单位攻击、移速+30%，最大生命值+50%，精英和领袖敌人登场30秒内受到的物理和法术伤害-50%，盲目者所见中的险路恶敌出现额外敌人
zh.flavor: 丛林里怎么会有这种奇怪的设计图，附注的文字是哪种语言？它描绘的奇异生物又是怎么回事，天外生命降临黑流树海的传闻难道是真的？
zh.unlock: 【内容拓展 · 一】后，完成一次游戏结局

en.name: 'Civilight Eterna'
en.effect: All enemies take +150% True damage
en.flavor: A small, black crown.

zh.name: “文明的存续”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的真实伤害+150%
zh.flavor: 小小的黑色王冠。

en.name: 'Glory Pack'
en.effect: When an allied unit is defeated, all enemies in the four adjacent tiles are stunned for 6 seconds
en.flavor: A special betting method set up by the organizers for the knight competition season. Diversify your bets with various plans to minimize losses on any match.

zh.name: “荣耀套餐”
zh.effect: 我方单位被击倒时，对周围四格的敌人造成6秒晕眩
zh.flavor: 主办方在骑士竞赛期间推出的特别投注设备，优选多种叠加互补投注套餐，将单场比赛投注的损失降至最低。

en.name: 'End of Times'
en.effect: For one time only, if you would fail any battle other than the final battle of the area or a Leader battle, you instead gain +1 Life Point and advance to the next step instead of concluding the exploration
en.flavor: As long as a new cycle has not been reached, there is still time to fix your mistakes.
en.unlock: In a single battle, lose a total of 8 Life Points (including mission failures)

zh.name: “时光之末”
zh.effect: 仅一次，在非区域最终战斗和领袖战中失败时不结束探索，目标生命+1并继续下一步行动
zh.flavor: 只要到达不了新的循环，过错就还有机会挽回。
zh.unlock: 在一次战斗中累计失去8目标生命（包含战斗失败）

en.name: 'Little Gran Faro'
en.effect: Stuns all enemy units for 5 seconds every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point
en.flavor: An illumination device reverse-engineered from the Eye of Iberia. It can penetrate thick, dark clouds and temporarily repel powerful enemies.
en.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Life Points

zh.name: “小格兰法洛”
zh.effect: 每次敌人进入保护目标点时，立刻对全场所有敌人造成5秒晕眩
zh.flavor: 使用逆向工程分析“伊比利亚之眼”后制作的照射装置，能够洞穿层层阴云，也可暂时驱退强敌。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计损失125目标生命

en.name: 'Memories of The Shard'
en.effect: Deals 5000 True damage to all enemy units every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point
en.flavor: 'Still impaled on Victoria's heart, it watches as the empire bleeds.'

zh.name: “碎片大厦的回忆”
zh.effect: 每次敌人进入保护目标点时，立刻对全场所有敌人造成5000点真实伤害
zh.flavor: “它正扎在维多利亚的心脏上，眼看着这个帝国流尽鲜血。”

en.name: HR Bronze Seal
en.effect: Recruit a random 5-star Operator that is automatically Promoted
en.flavor: Emblem assigned to specific Operators when ■■■ receives an emergency deployment command. Your receipt of it signifies that ■■■ has completed the assignment.

zh.name: 人事部铜印
zh.effect: 随机临时招募1名5星干员，且直接就是已进阶的状态
zh.flavor: ■■■收到紧急部署口令后派发给特定干员的印记，你得到它就代表着■■■已完成嘱托。

en.name: Doctor Silver Seal
en.effect: Recruit a random 6-star Operator that is automatically Promoted
en.flavor: Emblem that you instructed to be sent out at the right time before you left. Your selected Operator has joined the field mission at the camp, while handing it back to you the way you left it.
en.unlock: Reach a Squad Size Limit of 13 at any point

zh.name: 博士银印
zh.effect: 随机临时招募1名6星干员，且直接就是已进阶的状态
zh.flavor: 这块印记是你出发前嘱咐指挥中枢在合适时间送出的，现在你选定的干员已经赶到宿营处加入外勤任务，顺带把东西原封不动交还给了你。
zh.unlock: 在任意时刻拥有不小于13个可携带干员数

en.name: Rainbow Jar
en.effect: Whenever an enemy enters the Objective Point, the Redeployment Time of a random Operator waiting to be re-deployed is reduced to 0
en.flavor: The Sami usually place it where a rainbow touches down and keep it with great care, to ward off catastrophes and calamities that come and go without a trace.

zh.name: 彩虹瓮
zh.effect: 每次敌人进入保护目标点时，使随机一名再部署中的单位当前再部署时间减为0
zh.flavor: 它通常被萨米人放在彩虹落下的地方并精心保存，用以对抗踪迹不定的天灾与人祸。

en.name: Coin Geists
en.effect: All Operators have -1 DP Cost; at the start of battle, all Operators' DP Costs are shuffled
en.flavor: Eight coins turned into one geist, but they retain their own minds. Even when one grabs the thread binding them together, they may stay defiant.

zh.name: 一串钱伥
zh.effect: 所有干员的部署费用-1，战斗开始时，打乱所有干员的部署费用
zh.flavor: 八钱一体，成伥后却各有想法。即使抓住串起它们的线，也并不老实。
